17:41.t: Moreover, for man's warning have we varied this Koran: Yet it only increaseth their flight from it

17:42.t: SAY: If, as ye affirm, there were other gods with Him, they would in that case seek occasion against the occupant of the throne

17:43.t: Glory to Him! Immensely high is He exalted above their blasphemies

17:44.t: The seven heavens praise him, and the earth, and all who are therein; neither is there aught which doth not celebrate his praise; but their utterances of praise ye understand not. He is kind, indulgent

17:45.t: When thou recitest the Koran we place between thee and those who believe not in the life to come, a dark veil

17:46.t: And we put coverings over their hearts lest they should understand it, and in their ears a heaviness; And when in the Koran thou namest thy One Lord, they turn their backs in flight

17:47.t: We well know why they hearken, when they hearken unto thee, and when they whisper apart; when the wicked say, "Ye follow no other than a man enchanted

17:48.t: See what likenesses they strike out for thee! But they are in error, neither can they find the path

17:49.t: They also say, "After we shall have become bones and dust, shall we in sooth be raised a new creation

17:50.t: SAY: "Yes, though ye were stones, or iron

17:51.t: or any other creature, to your seeming, yet harder to be raised." But they will say, "Who shall bring us back?" SAY: "He who created you at first." And they will wag their heads at thee, and say, "When shall this be?" SAY: "Haply it is nigh

17:52.t: On that day shall God call you forth, and ye shall answer by praising Him; and ye shall seem to have tarried but a little while

17:53.t: Enjoin my servants to speak in kindly sort: Verily Satan would stir up strifes among them, for Satan is man's avowed foe

17:54.t: Your Lord well knoweth you: if He please He will have mercy on you; or if He please He will chastise you: and we have not sent thee to be a guardian over them

17:55.t: Thy Lord hath full knowledge of all in the heavens and the earth. Higher gifts have we given to some of the prophets than to others, and the Psalter we gave to David

17:56.t: SAY: Call ye upon those whom ye fancy to be gods beside Him; yet they will have no power to relieve you from trouble, or to shift it elsewhere

17:57.t: Those whom ye call on, themselves desire union with their Lord, striving which of them shall be nearest to him: they also hope for his mercy and fear his chastisement. Verily the chastisement of thy Lord is to be dreaded

17:58.t: There is no city which we will not destroy before the day of Resurrection, or chastise it with a grievous chastisement. This is written in the Book

17:59.t: Nothing hindered us from sending thee with the power of working miracles, except that the peoples of old treated them as lies. We gave to Themoud the she-camel before their very eyes, yet they maltreated her! We send not a prophet with miracles but to strike terror

17:60.t: And remember when we said to thee, Verily, thy Lord is round about mankind; we ordained the vision which we shewed thee, and likewise the cursed tree of the Koran, only for men to dispute of; we will strike them with terror; but it shall only increase in them enormous wickedness

17:61.t: And when we said to the Angels, "Prostrate yourselves before Adam:" and they all prostrated them, save Eblis. "What!" said he, "shall I bow me before him whom thou hast created of clay

17:62.t: Seest thou this man whom thou hast honoured above me? Verily, if thou respite me till the day of Resurrection, I will destroy his offspring, except a few

17:63.t: He said, "Begone; but whosoever of them shall follow thee, verily, Hell shall be your recompense; an ample recompense

17:64.t: And entice such of them as thou canst by thy voice; assault them with thy horsemen and thy footmen; be their partner in their riches and in their children, and make them promises: but Satan shall make them only deceitful promises

17:65.t: As to my servants, no power over them shalt thou have; And thy Lord will be their sufficient guardian

17:66.t: It is your Lord who speedeth onward the ships for you in the sea, that ye may seek of his abundance; for he is merciful towards you

17:67.t: When a misfortune befalleth you out at sea, they whom ye invoke are not to be found: God alone is there: yet when he bringeth you safe to dry land, ye place yourselves at a distance from Him. Ungrateful is man

17:68.t: What! are ye sure, then, that he will not cleave the sides of the earth for you? or that he will not send against you a whirlwind charged with sands? Then shall ye find no protector

17:69.t: Or are ye sure that he will not cause you to put back to sea a second time, and send against you a storm blast, and drown you, for that ye have been thankless? Then shall ye find no helper against us therein

17:70.t: And now have we honoured the children of Adam: by land and by sea have we carried them: food have we provided for them of good things, and with endowments beyond many of our creatures have we endowed them

17:71.t: One day we will summon all men with their leaders: they whose book shall be given into their right hand, shall read their book, and not be wronged a thread

17:72.t: And he who has been blind here, shall be blind hereafter, and wander yet more from the way

17:73.t: And, verily, they had well nigh beguiled thee from what we revealed to thee, and caused thee to invent some other thing in our name: but in that case they would surely have taken thee as a friend

17:74.t: And had we not settled thee, thou hadst well nigh leaned to them a little

17:75.t: In that case we would surely have made thee taste of woe in life and of woe in death: then thou shouldest not have found a helper against us

17:76.t: And truly they had almost caused thee to quit the land, in order wholly to drive thee forth from it: but then, themselves should have tarried but a little after thee

17:77.t: This was our way with the Apostles we have already sent before thee, and in this our way thou shalt find no change

17:78.t: Observe prayer at sunset, till the first darkening of the night, and the daybreak reading - for the daybreak reading hath its witnesses

17:79.t: And watch unto it in the night: this shall be an excess in service: it may be that thy Lord will raise thee to a glorious station

17:80.t: And say, "O my Lord, cause me to enter with a perfect entry, and to come forth with a perfect forthcoming, and give me from thy presence a helping power

17:81.t: And SAY: Truth is come and falsehood is vanished. Verily, falsehood is a thing that vanisheth

17:82.t: And we send down of the Koran that which is a healing and a mercy to the faithful: But it shall only add to the ruin of the wicked

17:83.t: When we bestow favours on man, he withdraweth and goeth aside; but when evil toucheth him, he is despairing

17:84.t: SAY: Every one acteth after his own manner: but your Lord well knoweth who is best guided in his path

17:85.t: And they will ask thee of the Spirit. SAY: The Spirit proceedeth at my Lord's command: but of knowledge, only a little to you is given

17:86.t: If we pleased, we could take away what we have revealed to thee: none couldst thou then find thee to undertake thy cause with us

17:87.t: Save as a mercy from thy Lord; great, verily, is his favour towards thee

17:88.t: SAY: Verily, were men and Djinn assembled to produce the like of this Koran, they could not produce its like, though the one should help the other

17:89.t: And of a truth we have set out to men every kind of similitude in this Koran, but most men have refused everything except unbelief

17:90.t: And they say, "By no means will we believe on thee till thou cause a fountain to gush forth for us from the earth

17:91.t: Or, till thou have a garden of palm-trees and grapes, and thou cause forth-gushing rivers to gush forth in its midst

17:92.t: Or thou make the heaven to fall on us, as thou hast given out, in pieces; or thou bring God and the angels to vouch for thee

17:93.t: Or thou have a house of gold; or thou mount up into Heaven; nor will we believe in thy mounting up, till thou send down to us a book which we may read." SAY: Praise be to my Lord! Am I more than a man, an apostle

17:94.t: And what hindereth men from believing, when the guidance hath come to them, but that they say, "Hath God sent a man as an apostle

17:95.t: SAY: Did angels walk the earth as its familiars, we had surely sent them an angel - apostle out of Heaven

17:96.t: SAY: God is witness enough between you and me. His servants He scanneth, eyeth

17:97.t: And He whom God shall guide will be guided indeed; and whom he shall mislead thou shalt find none to assist, but Him: and we will gather them together on the day of the resurrection, on their faces, blind and dumb and deaf: Hell shall be their abode: so oft as its fires die down, we will rekindle the flame

17:98.t: This shall be their reward for that they believed not our signs and said, "When we shall have become bones and dust, shall we surely be raised a new creation

17:99.t: Do they not perceive that God, who created the Heavens and the Earth, is able to create their like? And he hath ordained them a term; there is no doubt of it: but the wicked refuse everything except unbelief

17:100.t: SAY: If ye held the treasures of my Lord's mercy ye would certainly refrain from them through fear of spending them: for man is covetous

17:101.t: We therefore gave to Moses nine clear signs. Ask thou, therefore, the children of Israel how it was when he came unto them, and Pharaoh said to him, "Verily, I deem thee, O Moses, a man enchanted

17:102.t: Said Moses, "Thou knowest that none hath sent down these clear signs but the Lord of the Heavens and of the Earth; and I surely deem thee, O Pharaoh, a person lost

17:103.t: So Pharaoh sought to drive them out of the land; but we drowned him and all his followers

17:104.t: And after his death, we said to the children of Israel, "Dwell ye in the land:" and when the promise of the next life shall come to pass, we will bring you both up together to judgment

17:105.t: In truth have we sent down the Koran, and in truth hath it descended, and we have only sent thee to announce and to warn

17:106.t: And we have parcelled out the Koran into sections, that thou mightest recite it unto men by slow degrees, and we have sent it down piecemeal

17:107.t: SAY: Believe ye therein or believe ye not? They verily to whom knowledge had been given previously, fall on their faces worshipping when it is recited to them

17:108.t: and say: "Glory be to God! the promise of our Lord is made good

17:109.t: They fall down on their faces weeping, and It increaseth their humility

17:110.t: , or call upon the God of Mercy
, by whichsoever ye will invoke him: He hath most excellent names. And be not loud in thy prayer, neither pronounce it too low; but between these follow a middle way

17:111.t: And SAY: Praise be to God who hath not begotten a son, who hath no partner in the Kingdom, nor any protector on account of weakness. And magnify him by proclaiming His greatness

18:1.t: PRAISE be to God, who hath sent down the Book to his servant, and hath not made it tortuous

18:2.t: But direct; that it may warn of a grievous woe from him, and announce to the faithful who do the things that are right, that a goodly reward

18:3.t: wherein they shall abide for ever, awaiteth them

18:4.t: And that it may warn those who say, "God hath begotten a Son

18:5.t: No knowledge of this have either they or their fathers! A grievous saying to come out of their mouths! They speak no other than a lie

18:6.t: And haply, if they believe not in this new revelation, thou wilt slay thyself, on their very footsteps, out of vexation

18:7.t: Verily, we have made all that is on earth as its adornment, that we might make trial who among mankind would excel in works

18:8.t: But we are surely about to reduce all that is thereon to dust

18:9.t: Hast thou reflected that the Inmates of THE CAVE and of Al Rakim were on our wondrous signs

18:10.t: When the youths betook them to the cave they said, "O our Lord! grant us mercy from before thee, and order for us our affair aright

18:11.t: Then struck we upon their ears with deafness in the cave for many a year

18:12.t: Then we awaked them that we might know which of the two parties could best reckon the space of their abiding

18:13.t: We will relate to thee their tale with truth. They were youths who had believed in their Lord, and in guidance had we increased them

18:14.t: And we had made them stout of heart, when they stood up and said, "Our Lord is Lord of the Heavens and of the Earth: we will call on no other God than Him; for in that case we had said a thing outrageous

18:15.t: These our people have taken other gods beside Him, though they bring no clear proof for them; but, who more iniquitous than he who forgeth a lie of God

18:16.t: So when ye shall have separated you from them and from that which they worship beside God, then betake you to the cave: Your Lord will unfold his mercy to you, and will order your affairs for you for the best

18:17.t: And thou mightest have seen the sun when it arose, pass on the right of their cave, and when it set, leave them on the left, while they were in its spacious chamber. This is one of the signs of God. Guided indeed is he whom God guideth; but for him whom He misleadeth, thou shalt by no means find a patron, director

18:18.t: And thou wouldst have deemed them awake, though they were sleeping: and we turned them to the right and to the left. And in the entry lay their dog with paws outstretched. Hadst thou come suddenly upon them, thou wouldst surely have turned thy back on them in flight, and have been filled with fear at them

18:19.t: So we awaked them that they might question one another. Said one of them, "How long have ye tarried here?" They said, "We have tarried a day or part of day." They said, "Your Lord knoweth best how long ye have tarried: Send now one of you with this your coin into the city, and let him mark who therein hath purest food, and from him let him bring you a supply: and let him be courteous, and not discover you to any one

18:20.t: For they, if they find you out, will stone you or turn you back to their faith, and in that case it will fare ill with you for ever

18:21.t: And thus made we their adventure known to their fellow citizens, that they might learn that the promise of God is true, and that as to "the Hour" there is no doubt of its coming. When they disputed among themselves concerning what had befallen them, some said, "Build a building over them; their Lord knoweth best about them." Those who prevailed in the matter said, "A place of worship will we surely raise over them

18:22.t: Some say, "They were three; their dog the fourth:" others say, "Five; their dog the sixth," guessing at the secret: others say, "Seven; and their dog the eighth." SAY: My Lord best knoweth the number: none, save a few, shall know them

18:23.t: Therefore be clear in they discussions about them, and ask not any Christian concerning them

18:24.t: Say not thou of a thing, " I will surely do it to-morrow;" without, "If God will." And when thou hast forgotten, call thy Lord to mind; and say, "Haply my Lord will guide me, that I may come near to the truth of this story with correctness

18:25.t: And they tarried in their cave 300 years, and 9 years over

18:26.t: SAY: God best knoweth how long they tarried: With Him are the secrets of the Heavens and of the Earth: Look thou and hearken unto Him alone. Man hath no guardian but Him, and none may bear part in his judgments

18:27.t: And publish what hath been revealed to thee of the Book of thy Lord - none may change his words, - and thou shalt find no refuge beside Him

18:28.t: Be patient with those who call upon their Lord at morn and even, seeking his face: and let not thine eyes be turned away from them in quest of the pomp of this life; neither obey him whose heart we have made careless of the remembrance of Us, and who followeth his own lusts, and whose ways are unbridled

18:29.t: And SAY: the truth is from your Lord: let him then who will, believe; and let him who will, be an infidel. But for the offenders we have got ready the fire whose smoke shall enwrap them: and if they implore help, helped shall they be with water like molten brass which shall scald their Wretched the drink! and an unhappy couch

18:30.t: But as to those who have believed and done the things that are right, - Verily we will not suffer the reward of him whose works were good, to perish

18:31.t: For them, the gardens of Eden, under whose shades shall rivers flow: decked shall they be therein with bracelets of gold, and green robes of silk and rich brocade shall they wear, reclining them therein on thrones. Blissful the reward! and a pleasant couch

18:32.t: And set forth to them as a parable two men; on one of whom we bestowed two gardens of grape vines, and surrounded both with palm trees, and placed corn fields between them

18:33.t: Each of the gardens did yield its fruit, and failed not thereof at all: And we caused a river to flow in their midst

18:34.t: And this man received his fruit, and said, disputing with him, to his companion, "More have I than thou of wealth, and my family is mightier

18:35.t: And he went into his garden - to his own soul unjust. He said, "I do not think that this will ever perish

18:36.t: And I do not think that 'the Hour' will come: and even if I be taken back to my Lord, I shall surely find a better than it in exchange

18:37.t: His fellow said to him, disputing with him, "What! hast thou no belief in him who created thee of the dust, then of the germs of life, then fashioned thee a perfect man

18:38.t: But God is my Lord; and no other being will I associate with my Lord

18:39.t: And why didst thou not say when thou enteredst thy garden, 'What God willeth! There is no power but in God.' Though thou seest that I have less than thou of wealth and children

18:40.t: Yet haply my Lord may bestow on me better than thy garden, and may send his bolts upon it out of Heaven, so that the next dawn shall find it barren dust

18:41.t: Or its water become deep sunk, so that thou art unable to find it

18:42.t: And his fruits were encompassed by destruction. Then began he to turn down the palms of his hands at what he had spent on it; for its vines were falling down on their trellises, and he said, "Oh that I had not joined any other god to my Lord

18:43.t: And he had no host to help him instead of God, neither was he able to help himself

18:44.t: Protection in such a case is of God - the Truth: He is the best rewarder, and He bringeth to the best issue

18:45.t: And set before them a similitude of the present life. It is as water which we send down from Heaven, and the herb of the Earth is mingled with it, and on the morrow it becometh dry stubble which the winds scatter: for God hath power over all things

18:46.t: Wealth and children are the adornment of this present life: but good works, which are lasting, are better in the sight of thy Lord as to recompense, and better as to hope

18:47.t: And call to mind the day when we will cause the mountains to pass away, and thou shalt see the earth a levelled plain, and we will gather mankind together, and not leave of them any one

18:48.t: And they shall be set before thy Lord in ranks: - "Now are ye come unto us as we created you at first: but ye thought that we should not make good to you the promise

18:49.t: And each shall have his book put into his hand: and thou shalt see the wicked in alarm at that which is therein: and they shall say, "O woe to us! what meaneth this Book? It leaveth neither small nor great unnoted down!" And they shall find all that they have wrought present to them, and thy Lord will not deal unjustly with any one

18:50.t: When we said to the angels, "Prostrate yourselves before Adam," they all prostrated them save Eblis, who was of the Djinn, and revolted from his Lord's behest. behest. - What! will ye then take him and his offspring as patrons rather than Me? and they your enemies? Sad exchange for the ungodly

18:51.t: I made them not witnesses of the creation of the Heavens and of the Earth, nor of their own creation, neither did I take seducers as my helpers

18:52.t: On a certain day, God shall say, "Call ye on the companions ye joined with me, deeming them to be gods:" and they shall call on them, but they shall not answer them: then will we place a valley of perdition between them

18:53.t: And the wicked shall see the fire, and shall have a foreboding that they shall be flung into it, and they shall find no escape from it

18:54.t: And now in this Koran we have presented to man similitudes of every kind: but, at most things is man a caviller

18:55.t: And what, now that guidance is come to them, letteth men from believing and from asking forgiveness of their Lord - unless they wait till that the doom of the ancients overtake them, or the chastisement come upon them in the sight of the universe

18:56.t: We send not our Sent Ones but to announce and to warn: but the infidels cavil with vain words in order to refute the truth; and they treat my signs and their own warnings with scorn

18:57.t: But who is worse than he who when told of the signs of his Lord turneth him away and forgetteth what in time past his hands have wrought? Truly we have thrown veils over their hearts lest they should understand this Koran, and into their ears a heaviness: And if thou bid them to "the guidance" yet will they not even then be guided ever

18:58.t: The gracious one, full of compassion, is thy Lord! if he would have chastised them for their demerits he would have hastened their chastisement. But they have a time fixed for the accomplishment of our menaces: and beside God they shall find no refuge

18:59.t: And those cities did we destroy when they became impious; and of their coming destruction we gave them warning

18:60.t: Remember when Moses said to his servant, "I will not stop till I reach the confluence of the two seas, or for years will I journey on

18:61.t: But when they reached their confluence, they forgot their fish, and it took its way in the sea at will

18:62.t: And when they had passed on, said Moses to his servant, "Bring us our morning meal; for now have we incurred weariness from this journey

18:63.t: He said, "What thinkest thou? When we repaired to the rock for rest I forgot the fish; and none but Satan made me forget it, so as not to mention it; and it hath taken its way in the sea in a wondrous sort

18:64.t: He said, "It is this we were in quest of." And they both went back retracing their footsteps

18:65.t: Then found they one of our servants to whom we had vouchsafed our mercy, and whom we had instructed with our knowledge

18:66.t: And Moses said to him, "Shall I follow thee that thou teach me, for guidance, of that which thou too hast been taught

18:67.t: He said, "Verily, thou canst not have patience with me

18:68.t: How canst thou be patient in matters whose meaning thou comprehendest not

18:69.t: He said, "Thou shalt find me patient if God please, nor will I disobey thy bidding

18:70.t: He said, "Then, if thou follow me, ask me not of aught until I have given thee an account thereof

18:71.t: So they both went on, till they embarked in a ship, and he - the unknown - staved it in. "What!" said Moses, "hast thou staved it in that thou mayest drown its crew? a strange thing now hast thou done

18:72.t: He said, "Did I not tell thee that thou couldst not have patience with me

18:73.t: He said, "Chide me not that I forgat, nor lay on me a hard command

18:74.t: Then went they on till they met a youth, and he slew him. Said Moses, "Hast thou slain him who is free from guilt of blood? Now hast thou wrought a grievous thing

18:75.t: He said, "Did I not tell thee that thou couldst not have patience with me

18:76.t: Moses said, "If after this I ask thee aught, then let me be thy comrade no longer; but now hast thou my excuse

18:77.t: They went on till they came to the people of a city. Of this people they asked food, but they refused them for guests. And they found in it a wall that was about to fall, and he set it upright. Said Moses, "If thou hadst wished, for this thou mightest have obtained pay

18:78.t: He said, "This is the parting point between me and thee. But I will first tell thee the meaning of that which thou couldst not await with patience

18:79.t: As to the vessel, it belonged to poor men who toiled upon the sea, and I was minded to damage it, for in their rear was a king who seized every ship by force

18:80.t: As to the youth his parents were believers, and we feared lest he should trouble them by error and infidelity

18:81.t: And we desired that their Lord might give them in his place a child, better than he in virtue, and nearer to filial piety

18:82.t: And as to the wall, it belonged to two orphan youths in the city, and beneath it was their treasure: and their father was a righteous man: and thy Lord desired that they should reach the age of strength, and take forth their treasure through the mercy of thy Lord. And not of mine own will have I done this. This is the interpretation of that which thou couldst not bear with patience

18:83.t: They will ask thee of Dhoulkarnain
. SAY: I will recite to you an account of him

18:84.t: We stablished his power upon the earth, and made for him a way to everything

18:86.t: Until when he reached the setting of the sun, he found it to set in a miry fount; and hard by he found a people. We said, "O Dhoulkarnain! either chastise or treat them generously

18:87.t: The impious," said he, "will we surely chastise;" then shall he be taken back to his Lord, and he will chastise him with a grievous chastisement

18:88.t: But as to him who believeth and doeth that which is right, he shall have a generous recompense, and we will lay on them our easy behests

18:90.t: Until when he reached the rising of the sun he found it to rise on a people to whom we had given no shelter from it

18:91.t: Thus it was. And we had full knowledge of the forces that were with him

18:93.t: Until he came between the two mountains, beneath which he found a people who scarce understood a language

18:94.t: They said, "O Dhoulkarnain! verily, Gog and Magog waste this land; shall we then pay thee tribute, so thou build a rampart between us and them

18:95.t: He said, "Better than your tribute is the might wherewith my Lord hath strengthened me; but help me strenuously, and I will set a barrier between you and them

18:96.t: Bring me blocks of iron," - until when it filled the space between the mountain sides - "Ply," said he, "your bellows," - until when he had made it red with heat
, he said, - "Bring me molten brass that I may pour upon it

18:97.t: And Gog and Magog were not able to scale it, neither were they able to dig through it

18:98.t: This," said he, "is a mercy from my Lord: But when the promise of my Lord shall come to pass, he will turn it to dust; and the promise of my Lord is true

18:99.t: On that day we will let them dash like billows one over another; and there shall be a blast on the trumpet, and we will gather them together in a body

18:100.t: And we will set Hell on that day close before the infidels

18:101.t: Whose eyes were veiled from my warning, and who had no power to hear

18:102.t: What! do the infidels think that they can take my servants as their patrons, beside Me? Verily, we have got Hell ready as the abode of the infidels

18:103.t: SAY: Shall we tell you who they are that have lost their labour most

18:104.t: Whose aim in the present life hath been mistaken, and who deem that what they do is right

18:105.t: They are those who believe not in the signs of the Lord, or that they shall ever meet him. Vain, therefore, are their works; and no weight will we allow them on the day of resurrection

18:106.t: This shall be their reward - Hell. Because they were unbelievers, and treated my signs and my Apostles with scorn

18:107.t: But as for those who believe and do the things that are right, they shall have the gardens of Paradise for their abode

18:108.t: They shall remain therein for ever: they shall wish for no change from it

18:109.t: SAY: Should the sea become ink, to write the words of my Lord, the sea would surely fail ere the words of my Lord would fail, though we brought its like in aid

18:110.t: SAY: In sooth I am only a man like you. It hath been revealed to me that your God is one only God: let him then who hopeth to meet his Lord work a righteous work: nor let him give any other creature a share in the worship of his Lord

19:2.t: A recital of thy Lord's mercy to his servant Zachariah

19:3.t: When he called upon his Lord with secret calling

19:4.t: And said: "O Lord, verily my bones are weakened, and the hoar hairs glisten on my head, And never, Lord, have I prayed to thee with ill success

19:5.t: But now I have fears for my kindred after me; and my wife is barren: Give me, then, a successor as thy special gift

19:6.t: who shall be my heir and an heir of the family of Jacob: and make him, Lord, well pleasing to thee

19:7.t: O Zachariah! verily we announce to thee a son, - his name John: That name We have given to none before him

19:8.t: He said: "O my Lord! how when my wife is barren shall I have a son, and when I have now reached old age, failing in my powers

19:9.t: He said: So shall it be. Thy Lord hath said, Easy is this to me, for I created thee aforetime when thou wast nothing

19:10.t: He said: "Vouchsafe me, O my Lord! a sign." He said: "Thy sign shall be that for three nights, though sound in health, thou speakest not to man

19:11.t: And he came forth from the sanctuary to his people, and made signs to them to sing praises morn and even

19:12.t: We said: "O John! receive the Book with purpose of heart:" - and We bestowed on him wisdom while yet a child

19:13.t: And mercifulness from Ourself, and purity; and pious was he

19:14.t: and duteous to his parents; and not proud, rebellious

19:15.t: And peace was on him on the day he was born, and the day of his death, and shall be on the day when he shall be raised to life

19:16.t: And make mention in the Book, of Mary, when she went apart from her family, eastward

19:17.t: And took a veil to shroud herself from them: and we sent our spirit to her, and he took before her the form of a perfect man

19:18.t: She said: "I fly for refuge from thee to the God of Mercy! If thou fearest Him, begone from me

19:19.t: He said: "I am only a messenger of thy Lord, that I may bestow on thee a holy son

19:20.t: She said: "How shall I have a son, when man hath never touched me? and I am not unchaste

19:21.t: He said: "So shall it be. Thy Lord hath said: 'Easy is this with me;' and we will make him a sign to mankind, and a mercy from us. For it is a thing decreed

19:22.t: And she conceived him, and retired with him to a far-off place

19:23.t: And the throes came upon her by the trunk of a palm. She said: "Oh, would that I had died ere this, and been a thing forgotten, forgotten quite

19:24.t: And one cried to her from below her: "Grieve not thou, thy Lord hath provided a streamlet at thy feet

19:25.t: And shake the trunk of the palm-tree toward thee: it will drop fresh ripe dates upon thee

19:26.t: Eat then and drink, and be of cheerful eye: and shouldst thou see a man, Say, - Verily, I have vowed abstinence to the God of mercy. - To no one will I speak this day

19:27.t: Then came she with the babe to her people, bearing him. They said, "O Mary! now hast thou done a strange thing

19:28.t: O sister of Aaron! Thy father was not a man of wickedness, nor unchaste thy mother

19:29.t: And she made a sign to them, pointing towards the babe. They said, "How shall we speak with him who is in the cradle, an infant

19:30.t: It said, "Verily, I am the servant of God; He hath given me the Book, and He hath made me a prophet

19:31.t: And He hath made me blessed wherever I may be, and hath enjoined me prayer and almsgiving so long as I shall live

19:32.t: And to be duteous to her that bare me: and he hath not made me proud, depraved

19:33.t: And the peace of God was on me the day I was born, and will be the day I shall die, and the day I shall be raised to life

19:34.t: This is Jesus, the son of Mary; this is a statement of the truth concerning which they doubt

19:35.t: It beseemeth not God to beget a son. Glory be to Him! when he decreeth a thing, He only saith to it, Be, and it Is

19:36.t: And verily, God is my Lord and your Lord; adore Him then. This is the right way

19:37.t: But the Sects have fallen to variance among themselves about Jesus: but woe, because of the assembly of a great day, to those who believe not

19:38.t: Make them hear, make them behold the day when they shall come before us! But the offenders this day are in a manifest error

19:39.t: Warn them of the day of sighing when the decree shall be accomplished, while they are sunk in heedlessness and while they believe not

19:40.t: Verily, we will inherit the earth and all who are upon it. To us shall they be brought back

19:41.t: Make mention also in the Book of Abraham; for he was a man of truth, a Prophet

19:42.t: When he said to his Father, "O my Father! why dost thou worship that which neither seeth nor heareth, nor profiteth thee aught

19:43.t: O my Father! verily now hath knowledge come to me which hath not come to thee. Follow me therefore - I will guide thee into an even path

19:44.t: O my Father! worship not Satan, for Satan is a rebel against the God of Mercy

19:45.t: O my Father! indeed I fear lest a chastisement from the God of Mercy light upon thee, and thou become Satan's vassal

19:46.t: He said, "Castest thou off my gods, O Abraham? If thou forbear not, I will surely stone thee. Begone from me for a length of time

19:47.t: He said, "Peace be on thee! I will pray my Lord for thy forgiveness, for he is gracious to me

19:48.t: But I will separate myself from you, and the gods ye call on beside God, and on my Lord will I call. Haply, my prayers to my Lord will not be with ill success

19:49.t: And when he had separated himself from them and that which they worshipped beside God, we bestowed on him Isaac and Jacob, and each of them we made a prophet

19:50.t: And we bestowed gifts on them in our mercy, and gave them the lofty tongue of truth

19:51.t: And commemorate Moses in "the Book;" for he was a man of purity: moreover he was an Apostle, a Prophet

19:52.t: From the right side of the mountain we called to him, and caused him to draw nigh to us for secret converse

19:53.t: And we bestowed on him in our mercy his brother Aaron, a Prophet

19:54.t: And commemorate Ismael in "the Book;" for he was true to his promise, and was an Apostle, a Prophet

19:55.t: And he enjoined prayer and almsgiving on his people, and was well pleasing to his Lord

19:56.t: And commemorate Edris in "the Book;" for he was a man of truth, a Prophet

19:57.t: And we uplifted him to a place on high

19:58.t: These are they among the prophets of the posterity of Adam, and among those whom we bare with Noah, and among the posterity of Abraham and Israel, and among those whom we have guided and chosen, to whom God hath shewed favour. When the signs of the God of Mercy were rehearsed to them, they bowed them down worshipping and weeping

19:59.t: But others have come in their place after them: they have made an end of prayer, and have gone after their own lusts; and in the end they shall meet with evil

19:60.t: Save those who turn and believe and do that which is right, these shall enter the Garden, and in nought shall they be wronged

19:61.t: The Garden of Eden, which the God of Mercy hath promised to his servants, though yet unseen: for his promise shall come to pass

19:62.t: No vain discourse shall they hear therein, but only "Peace;" and their food shall be given them at morn and even

19:63.t: This is the Paradise which we will make the heritage of those our servants who fear us

19:64.t: We come not down from Heaven but by thy Lord's command. His, whatever is before us and whatever is behind us, and whatever is between the two! And thy Lord is not forgetful

19:65.t: Lord of the Heavens and of the Earth, and of all that is between them! Worship Him, then, and abide thou steadfast in his worship. Knowest thou any other of the same name

19:66.t: Man saith: "What! after I am dead, shall I in the end be brought forth alive

19:67.t: Doth not man bear in mind that we made him at first, when he was nought

19:68.t: And I swear by thy Lord, we will surely gather together them and the Satans: then will we set them on their knees round Hell

19:69.t: Then will we take forth from each band those of them who have been stoutest in rebellion against the God of Mercy

19:70.t: Then shall we know right well to whom its burning is most due

19:71.t: No one is there of you who shall not go down unto it - This is a settled decree with thy Lord

19:72.t: Then will we deliver those who had the fear of God, and the wicked will we leave in it on their knees

19:73.t: And when our clear signs are rehearsed to them, the infidels say to those who believe: "Which of the two parties is in the best plight? and which is the most goodly company

19:74.t: But how many generations have we brought to ruin before them, who surpassed them in riches and in splendour

19:75.t: SAY: As to those who are in error, the God of Mercy will lengthen out to them a length of days Until they see that with which they are threatened, whether it be some present chastisement, or whether it be "the Hour," and they shall then know which is in the worse state, and which the more weak in forces

19:76.t: But God will increase the guidance of the already guided. And good works which abide, are in thy Lord's sight better in respect of guerdon, and better in the issue than all worldly good

19:77.t: Hast thou marked him who believeth not in our signs, and saith, "I shall surely have riches and children bestowed upon me

19:78.t: Hath he mounted up into the secrets of God? Hath he made a compact with the God of Mercy

19:79.t: No! we will certainly write down what he saith, and will lengthen the length of his chastisement

19:80.t: And we will inherit what he spake of, and he shall come before us all alone

19:81.t: They have taken other gods beside God to be their help

19:82.t: But it shall not be. Those gods will disavow their worship and will become their enemies

19:83.t: Seest thou not that we send the Satans against the Infidels to urge them into sin

19:84.t: Wherefore be not thou in haste with them; for a small number of days do we number to them

19:85.t: One day we will gather the God-fearing before the God of Mercy with honours due

19:86.t: But the sinners will we drive unto Hell, like flocks driven to the watering

19:87.t: None shall have power to intercede, save he who hath received permission at the hands of the God of Mercy

19:88.t: They say: "The God of Mercy hath gotten offspring

19:89.t: Now have ye done a monstrous thing

19:90.t: Almost might the very Heavens be rent thereat, and the Earth cleave asunder, and the mountains fall down in fragments

19:91.t: That they ascribe a son to the God of Mercy

19:92.t: when it beseemeth not the God of Mercy to beget a son

19:93.t: Verily there is none in the Heavens and in the Earth but shall approach the God of Mercy as a servant

19:94.t: He hath taken note of them, and numbered them with exact numbering

19:95.t: And each of them shall come to Him, on the day of Resurrection, singly

19:96.t: But love will the God of Mercy vouchsafe to those who believe and do the things that be right

19:97.t: Verily we have made this Koran easy and in thine own tongue, that thou mayest announce glad tidings by it to the God-fearing, and that thou mayest warn the contentious by it

19:98.t: How many generations have we destroyed before them! Canst thou search out one of them? or canst thou hear a whisper from them

20:2.t: Not to sadden thee have we sent down this Koran to thee

20:3.t: But as a warning for him who feareth

20:4.t: It is a missive from Him who hath made the earth and the lofty heavens

20:5.t: The God of Mercy sitteth on his throne

20:6.t: His, whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is in the earth, and whatsoever is between them both, and whatsoever is beneath the humid soil

20:7.t: Thou needest not raise thy voice: for He knoweth the secret whisper, and the yet more hidden

20:8.t: God! There is no God but He! Most excellent His titles

20:9.t: Hath the history of Moses reached thee

20:10.t: When he saw a fire, and said to his family, "Tarry ye here, for I perceive a fire: Haply I may bring you a brand from it, or find at the fire a guide

20:11.t: And when he came to it, he was called to, "O Moses

20:12.t: Verily, I am thy Lord:. therefore pull off thy shoes: for thou art in the holy valley of Towa

20:13.t: And I have chosen thee: hearken then to what shall be revealed

20:14.t: Verily, I am God: there is no God but me: therefore worship me, and observe prayer for a remembrance of me

20:15.t: Verily the hour is coming: - I all but manifest it - That every soul may be recompensed for its labours

20:16.t: Nor let him who believeth not therein and followeth his lust, turn thee aside from this truth, and thou perish

20:17.t: Now, what is that in thy right hand, O Moses

20:18.t: Said he, "It is my staff on which I lean, and with which I beast down leaves for my sheep, and I have other uses for it

20:19.t: He said, "Cast it down, O Moses

20:20.t: So he cast it down, and lo! it became a serpent that ran along

20:21.t: He said, "Lay hold on it, and fear not: to its former state will we restore it

20:22.t: Now place thy right hand to thy arm-pit: it shall come forth white, but unhurt: - another sign

20:23.t: That We may shew thee the greatest of our signs

20:24.t: Go to Pharaoh, for he hath burst all bounds

20:25.t: He said, "O my Lord! enlarge my breast for me

20:26.t: And make my work easy for me

20:27.t: And loose the knot of my tongue

20:28.t: That they may understand my speech

20:29.t: And give me a counsellor from among my family

20:31.t: By him gird up my loins

20:32.t: And make him a colleague in my work

20:33.t: That we may praise thee oft

20:36.t: He said, "O Moses, thou hast obtained thy suit

20:37.t: Already, at another time, have we showed thee favour

20:38.t: When we spake unto thy mother what was spoken

20:39.t: Cast him into the ark: then cast him on the sea
, and the sea shall throw him on the shore: and an enemy to me and an enemy to him shall take him up.' And I myself have made thee an object of love, That thou mightest be reared in mine eye

20:40.t: When thy sister went and said, 'Shall I shew you one who will nurse him?' Then We returned thee to thy mother that her eye might be cheered, and that she might not grieve. And when thou slewest a person, We delivered thee from trouble, and We tried thee with other trial. For years didst thou stay among the people of Midian; then camest thou hither by my decree, O Moses

20:41.t: And I have chosen thee for Myself

20:42.t: Go thou and thy brother with my signs and be not slack to remember me

20:43.t: Go ye to Pharaoh, for he hath burst all bounds

20:44.t: But speak ye to him with gentle speech; haply he will reflect or fear

20:45.t: They said, "O our Lord! truly we fear lest he break forth against us, or act with exceeding injustice

20:46.t: He said, "Fear ye not, for I am with you both. I will hearken and I will behold

20:47.t: Go ye then to him and say, 'Verily we are Sent ones of thy Lord; send therefore the children of Israel with us and vex them not: now are we come to thee with signs from thy Lord, and, Peace shall be on him who followeth the right guidance

20:48.t: For now hath it been revealed to us, that chastisement shall be on him who chargeth with falsehood, and turneth him away

20:49.t: And he said, "Who is your Lord, O Moses

20:50.t: He said, "Our Lord is He who hath given to everything its form and then guideth it aright

20:51.t: But what," said he, "was the state of generations past

20:52.t: He said, "The knowledge thereof is with my Lord in the Book of his decrees. My Lord erreth not, nor forgetteth

20:53.t: He hath spread the earth as a bed, and hath traced out paths for you therein, and hath sent down rain from Heaven, and by it we bring forth the kinds of various herbs

20:54.t: Eat ye, and feed your cattle.' Of a truth in this are signs unto men endued with understanding

20:55.t: From it have we created you, and into it will we return you, and out of it will we bring you forth a second time

20:56.t: And we shewed him all our signs: but he treated them as falsehoods, and refused to believe

20:57.t: He said, "Hast thou come, O Moses, to drive us from our land by thine enchantments

20:58.t: Therefore will we assuredly confront thee with like enchantments: so appoint a meeting between us and you - we will not fail it, we, and do not thou - in a place alike for both

20:59.t: He said, "On the feast day be your meeting, and in broad daylight let the people be assembled

20:60.t: And Pharaoh turned away, and collected his craftsmen and came

20:61.t: Said Moses to them, "Woe to you! devise not a lie against God: For then will he destroy you by a punishment. They who have lied have ever perished

20:62.t: And the magicians discussed their plan, and spake apart in secret

20:63.t: They said, "These two are surely sorcerers: fain would they drive you from your land by their sorceries, and lead away in their paths your chiefest men

20:64.t: So muster your craft: then come in order: well this day shall it be for him, who shall gain the upper hand

20:65.t: They said, "O Moses, wilt thou first cast down thy rod, or shall we be the first who cast

20:66.t: He said, "Yes, cast ye down first." And lo! by their enchantment their cords and rods seemed to him as if they ran

20:67.t: And Moses conceived a secret fear within him

20:68.t: We said, "Fear not, for thou shalt be the uppermost

20:69.t: Cast forth then what is in thy right hand: it shall swallow up what they have produced: they have only produced the deceit of an enchanter: and come where he may, ill shall an enchanter fare

20:70.t: And the magicians fell down and worshipped. They said, "We believe in the Lord of Aaron and of Moses

20:71.t: Said Pharaoh, "Believe ye on him ere I give you leave? He, in sooth, is your Master who hath taught you magic. I will therefore cut off your hands and your feet on opposite sides, and I will crucify you on trunks of the palm, and assuredly shall ye learn which of us is severest in punishing, and who is the more abiding

20:72.t: They said, "We will not have more regard to thee than to the clear tokens which have come to us, or than to Him who hath made us: doom the doom thou wilt: Thou canst only doom as to this present life

20:73.t: of a truth we have believed on our Lord that he may pardon us our sins and the sorcery to which thou hast forced us, for God is better, and more abiding than thou

20:74.t: As for him who shall come before his Lord laden with crime - for him verily is Hell: he shall not die in it and he shall not live

20:75.t: But he who shall come before Him, a believer, with righteous works, - these! the loftiest grades await them

20:76.t: Gardens of Eden, beneath whose trees the rivers flow: therein shall they abide for ever. This, the reward of him who hath been pure

20:77.t: Then revealed we to Moses, "Go forth by night with my servants and cleave for them a dry path in the sea; Fear not thou to be overtaken, neither be thou afraid

20:78.t: And Pharaoh followed them with his hosts, and the whelming billows of the sea overwhelmed them

20:79.t: for Pharaoh misled his people, and did not guide them

20:80.t: O children of Israel! we rescued you from your foes; and We appointed a meeting with you on the right side of the mountain; and We caused the manna and the quail to descend upon you

20:81.t: Eat," said We, "of the good things with which we have supplied you; but without excess, lest my wrath fall upon you; for on whom my wrath doth fall, he perisheth outright

20:82.t: Surely however will I forgive him who turneth to God and believeth, and worketh righteousness, and then yieldeth to guidance

20:83.t: But what hath hastened thee on apart from thy people, O Moses

20:84.t: He said, "They are hard on my footsteps: but to thee, O Lord, have I hastened, that thou mightest be well pleased with me

20:85.t: He said, "Of a truth now have we proved thy people since thou didst leave them, and Samiri had led them astray

20:86.t: And Moses returned to his people, angered, sorrowful. He said, "O my people! did not your Lord promise you a good promise? Was the time of my absence long to you? or desired ye that wrath from your Lord should light upon you, that ye failed in your promise to me

20:87.t: They said, "Not of our own accord have we failed in the promise to thee, but we were made to bring loads of the people's trinkets, and we threw them into the fire and Samiri likewise cast them in

20:88.t: and brought forth to them a corporeal lowing calf: and they said, "This is your God and the God of Moses, whom he hath forgotten

20:89.t: What! saw they not that it returned them no answer, and could neither hurt nor help them

20:90.t: And Aaron had before said to them, "O my people! by this calf are ye only proved: surely your Lord is the God of Mercy: follow me therefore and obey my bidding

20:91.t: They said, "We will not cease devotion to it, till Moses come back to us

20:92.t: He said, "O Aaron! when thou sawest that they had gone astray, what hindered thee

20:93.t: from following me? Hast thou then disobeyed my command

20:94.t: He said, "O Son of my mother! seize me not by my beard, nor by my head: indeed I feared lest thou shouldst say, Thou hast rent the children of Isreal asunder, and hast not observed my orders

20:95.t: He said, "And what was thy motive, O Samiri

20:96.t: He said, "I saw what they saw not: so I took a handful of dust from the track of the messenger of God, and flung it into the calf, for so my soul prompted me

20:97.t: He said, "Begone then: verily thy doom even in this life shall be to say, 'Touch me not.' And there is a threat against thee, which thou shalt not escape hereafter. Now look at thy god to which thou hast continued so devoted: we will surely burn it and reduce it to ashes, which we will cast into the sea

20:98.t: Your God is God, beside whom there is no God: In his knowledge he embraceth all things

20:99.t: Thus do We recite to thee histories of what passed of old; and from ourself have we given thee admonition

20:100.t: Whoso shall turn aside from it shall verily carry a burden on the day of Resurrection

20:101.t: Under it shall they remain: and grievous, in the day of Resurrection, shall it be to them to bear

20:102.t: On that day there shall be a blast on the trumpet, and We will gather the wicked together on that day with leaden eyes

20:103.t: They shall say in a low voice, one to another, - "Ye tarried but ten days on earth

20:104.t: We are most knowing with respect to that which they will say when the most veracious of them will say. "Ye have not tarried above a day

20:105.t: And they will ask thee of the mountains: SAY: scattering my Lord will scatter them in dust

20:106.t: And he will leave them a level plain

20:107.t: thou shalt see in it no hollows or jutting hills

20:108.t: On that day shall men follow their summoner - he marcheth straight on: and low shall be their voices before the God of Mercy, nor shalt thou hear aught but the light footfall

20:109.t: No intercession shall avail on that day, save his whom the God of Mercy shall allow to intercede, and whose words he shall approve

20:110.t: He knoweth their future and their past; but in their own knowledge they comprehend it not

20:111.t: And humble shall be their faces before Him that Liveth, the Self-subsisting: and undone he, who shall bear the burden of iniquity

20:112.t: But he who shall have done the things that are right and is a believer, shall fear neither wrong nor loss

20:113.t: Thus have We sent down to thee an Arabic Koran, and have set forth menaces therein diversely, that haply they may fear God, or that it may give birth to reflection in them

20:114.t: Exalted then be God, the King, the Truth! Be not hasty in its recital while the revelation of it to thee is incomplete. Say rather, "O my Lord, increase knowledge unto me

20:115.t: And of old We made a covenant with Adam; but he forgat it; and we found no firmness of purpose in him

20:116.t: And when We said to the angels, "Fall down and worship Adam," they worshipped all, save Eblis, who refused

20:117.t: and We said, "O Adam! this truly is a foe to thee and to thy wife. Let him not therefore drive you out of the garden, and ye become wretched

20:118.t: For to thee is it granted that thou shalt not hunger therein, neither shalt thou be naked

20:120.t: But Satan whispered him: said he, "O Adam! shall I shew thee the tree of Eternity, and the Kingdom that faileth not

20:121.t: And they both ate thereof, and their nakedness appeared to them, and they began to sew of the leaves of the Garden to cover them, and Adam disobeyed his Lord and went astray

20:122.t: Afterwards his Lord chose him for himself, and was turned towards him, and guided him

20:123.t: And God said, "Get ye all down hence, the one of you a foe unto the other. Hereafter shall guidance come unto you from me; And whoso followeth my guidance shall not err, and shall not be wretched

20:124.t: But whoso turneth away from my monition, his truly shall be a life of misery: And We will assemble him with others on the day of Resurrection, blind

20:125.t: He will say, "O my Lord! why hast thou assembled me with others, blind? whereas I was endowed with sight

20:126.t: He will answer, "Thus is it, because our signs came unto thee and thou didst forget them, and thus shalt thou be forgotten this day

20:127.t: Even thus will We recompense him who hath transgressed and hath not believed in the signs of his Lord; and assuredly the chastisement of the next world will be more severe and more lasting

20:128.t: Are not they, who walk the very places where they dwelt, aware how many generations we have destroyed before them? Verily in this are signs to men of insight

20:129.t: And had not a decree of respite from thy Lord first gone forth, their chastisement had at once ensued. Yet the time is fixed

20:130.t: Put up then with what they say; and celebrate the praise of thy Lord before the sunrise, and before its setting; and some time in the night do thou praise him, and in the extremes of the day, that thou haply mayest please Him

20:131.t: And strain not thine eye after what We have bestowed on divers of them - the braveries of this world - that we may thereby prove them. The portion which thy Lord will give, is better and more lasting

20:132.t: Enjoin prayer on thy family, and persevere therein. We ask not of thee to find thine own provision - we will provide for thee, and a happy issue shall there be to piety

20:133.t: But they say, "If he come not to us with a sign from his Lord...!" But have not clear proofs for the Koran come to them, in what is in the Books of old

20:134.t: And had We destroyed them by a chastisement before its time, they would surely have said, "O our Lord! How could we believe if thou didst not send unto us an Apostle that we might follow thy signs ere that we were humbled and disgraced

20:135.t: SAY: Each one of us awaiteth the end. Wait ye then, and ye shall know which of us have been followers of the even way, and who hath been the rightly guided

21:1.t: THIS people's reckoning hath drawn nigh, yet, sunk in carelessness, they turn aside

21:2.t: Every fresh warning that cometh to them from their Lord they only hear to mock it

21:3.t: Their hearts set on lusts: and they who have done this wrong say in secret discourse, "Is He more than a man like yourselves? What! will ye, with your eyes open, accede to sorcery

21:4.t: SAY: "My Lord knoweth what is spoken in the heaven and on the earth: He is the Hearer, the Knower

21:5.t: Nay," say they, "it is the medley of dreams: nay, he hath forged it: nay, he is a poet: let him come to us with a sign as the prophets of old were sent

21:6.t: Before their time, none of the cities which we have destroyed, believed: will these men, then, believe

21:7.t: And we sent none, previous to thee, but men to whom we had revealed ourselves. Ask ye the people who are warned by Scriptures, if ye know it not

21:8.t: We gave them not bodies which could dispense with food: and they were not to live for ever

21:9.t: Then made we good our promise to them; and we delivered them and whom we pleased, and we destroyed the transgressors

21:10.t: And now have we sent down to you "the book," in which is your warning: What, will ye not then understand

21:11.t: And how many a guilty city have we broken down, and raised up after it other peoples

21:12.t: And when they felt our vengeance, lo! they fled from it

21:13.t: Flee not," said the angels in mockery, "but come back to that wherein ye revelled, and to your abodes! Questions will haply be put to you

21:14.t: They said, "Oh, woe to us! Verily we have been evil doers

21:15.t: And this ceased not to be their cry, until we made them like reaped corn, extinct

21:16.t: We created not the heaven and the earth, and what is between them, for sport

21:17.t: Had it been our wish to find a pastime, we had surely found it in ourselves; - if to do so had been our will

21:18.t: Nay, we will hurl the truth at falsehood, and it shall smite it, and lo! it shall vanish. But woe be to you for what ye utter of God

21:19.t: All beings in the heaven and on the earth are His: and they who are in his presence disdain not his service, neither are they wearied

21:20.t: They praise Him night and day: they rest not

21:21.t: Have they taken gods from the earth who can quicken the dead

21:22.t: Had there been in either heaven or earth gods besides God, both surely had gone to ruin. But glory be to God, the Lord of the throne, beyond what they utter

21:23.t: He shall not be asked of his doings, but they shall be asked

21:24.t: Have they taken other gods beside Him? SAY; Bring forth your proofs that they are gods. This is the warning of those who are with me, and the warning of those who were before me: but most of them know not the truth, and turn aside

21:25.t: No apostle have we sent before thee to whom we did not reveal that "Verily there is no God beside me: therefore worship me

21:26.t: Yet they say, "The God of Mercy hath begotten issue from the angels." Glory be to Him! Nay, they are but His honoured servants

21:27.t: They speak not till He hath spoken; and they do His bidding

21:28.t: He knoweth what is before them and what is behind them; and no plea shall they offer Save for whom He pleaseth; and they tremble for fear of Him

21:29.t: And that angel among them who saith "I am a god beside Him," will we recompense with hell: in such sort will we recompense the offenders

21:30.t: Do not the infidels see that the heavens and the earth were both a solid mass, and that we clave them asunder, and that by means of water we give life to everything? Will they not then believe

21:31.t: And we set mountains on the earth lest it should move with them, and we made on it broad passages between them as routes for their guidance

21:32.t: And we made the heaven a roof strongly upholden; yet turn they away from its signs

21:33.t: And He it is who hath created the night and the day, and the sun and the moon, each moving swiftly in its sphere

21:34.t: At no time have we granted to man a life that shall last for ever: if thou then die, shall they live for ever

21:35.t: Every soul shall taste of death: and for trial will we prove you with evil and with good; and unto Us shall ye be brought back

21:36.t: And when the infidels see thee they receive thee only with scoffs: - "What! is this he who maketh such mention of your gods?" Yet when mention is made to them of the God of Mercy, they believe not

21:37.t: Man," say they, "is made up of haste." But I will shew you my signs: desire them not then to be hastened

21:38.t: They say, "When will this threat be made good? Tell us, if ye be men of truth

21:39.t: Did the infidels but know the time when they shall not be able to keep the fire of hell from their faces or from their backs, neither shall they be helped

21:40.t: But it shall come on them suddenly and shall confound them; and they shall not be able to put it back, neither shall they be respited

21:41.t: Other apostles have been scoffed at before thee: but that doom at which they mocked encompassed the scoffers

21:42.t: SAY: Who shall protect you by night and by day from the God of Mercy? Yet turn they away from the warning of their Lord

21:43.t: Have they gods beside Us who can defend them? For their own succour have they no power; neither shall the gods they join with God screen them from Us

21:44.t: Yes! we have given these men and their fathers enjoyments so long as their life lasted. What! see they not that we come to a land and straiten its borders Is it they who are the conquerors

21:45.t: SAY: I only warn you of what hath been revealed to me: but the deaf will not hear the call, whenever they are warned

21:46.t: Yet if a breath of thy Lord's chastisement touch them, they will assuredly say, "Oh! woe to us! we have indeed been offenders

21:47.t: Just balances will we set up for the day of the resurrection, neither shall any soul be wronged in aught; though, were a work but the weight of a grain of mustard seed, we would bring it forth to be weighed: and our reckoning will suffice

21:48.t: We gave of old to Moses and Aaron the illumination, and a light and a warning for the God-fearing

21:49.t: Who dread their Lord in secret, and who tremble for "the Hour

21:50.t: And this Koran which we have sent down is a blessed warning: will ye then disown it

21:51.t: Of old we gave unto Abraham his direction, for we knew him worthy

21:52.t: When he said to his Father and to his people, "What are these images to which ye are devoted

21:53.t: They said, "We found our fathers worshipping them

21:54.t: He said, "Truly ye and your fathers have been in a plain mistake

21:55.t: They said, "Hast thou come unto us in earnest? or art thou of those who jest

21:56.t: He said, "Nay, your Lord is Lord of the Heavens and of the Earth, who hath created them both; and to this am I one of those who witness

21:57.t: And, by God, I will certainly lay a plot against your idols, after ye shall have retired and turned your backs

21:58.t: So, he broke them all in pieces, except the chief of them, that to it they might return, inquiring

21:59.t: They said, "Who hath done this to our gods? Verily he is one of the unjust

21:60.t: They said, "We heard a youth make mention of them: they call him Abraham

21:61.t: They said, "Then bring him before the people's eyes, that they may witness against him

21:62.t: They said, "Hast thou done this to our gods, O Abraham

21:63.t: He said, "Nay, that their chief hath done it: but ask ye them, if they can speak

21:64.t: So they turned their thoughts upon themselves, and said, "Ye truly are the impious persons

21:65.t: Then became headstrong in their former error and exclaimed,"Thou knowest that these speak not

21:66.t: He said, "What! do ye then worship, instead of God, that which doth not profit you at all, nor injure you

21:67.t: Fie on you and on that ye worship instead of God! What! do ye not then understand

21:68.t: They said: "Burn him, and come to the succour of your gods: if ye will do anything at all

21:69.t: We said, "O fire! be thou cold, and to Abraham a safety

21:70.t: And they sought to lay a plot against him, but we made them the sufferers

21:71.t: And we brought him and Lot in safety to the land which we have blessed for all human beings

21:72.t: And we gave him Isaac and Jacob as a farther gift, and we made all of them righteous

21:73.t: We also made them models who should guide others by our command, and we inspired them with good deeds and constancy in prayer and almsgiving, and they worshipped us

21:74.t: And unto Lot we gave wisdom, and knowledge; and we rescued him from the city which wrought filthiness; for they were a people, evil, perverse

21:75.t: And we caused him to enter into our mercy, for he was of the righteous

21:76.t: And remember Noah when aforetime he cried to us and we heard him, and delivered him and his family from the great calamity

21:77.t: And we helped him against the people who treated our signs as impostures. An evil people verily were they, and we drowned them all

21:78.t: And David and Solomon; when they gave judgment concerning a field when some people's sheep had caused a waste therein; and we were witnesses of their judgment

21:79.t: And we gave Solomon insight into the affair; and on both of them we bestowed wisdom and knowledge. And we constrained the mountains and the birds to join with David in our praise: Our doing was it

21:80.t: And we taught David the art of making mail for you, to defend you from each other's violence: will ye therefore be thankful

21:81.t: And to Solomon we subjected we subjected the strongly blowing wind; it sped at his bidding to the land we had blessed; for we know all things

21:82.t: And sundry Satans who should dive for him and perform other work beside: and we kept watch over them

21:83.t: And remember Job: When he cried to his Lord, "Truly evil hath touched me: but thou art the most merciful of those who shew mercy

21:84.t: So we heard him, and lightened the burden of his woe; and we gave him back his family, and as many more with them, - a mercy from us, and a memorial for those who serve us

21:85.t: And Ismael, and Edris and Dhoulkefl-all steadfast in patience

21:86.t: And we caused them to enter into our mercy; for they were of the righteous

21:87.t: And Dhoulnoun; when he went on his way in anger, and thought that we had no power over him. But in the darkness he cried "There is no God but thou: Glory be unto Thee! Verily, I have been one of the evil doers

21:88.t: So we heard him and rescued him from misery: for thus rescue we the faithful

21:89.t: And Zacharias; when he called upon his Lord saying, "O my Lord, leave me not childless: but there is no better heir than Thyself

21:90.t: So we heard him, and gave him John, and we made his wife fit for child-bearing. Verily, these vied in goodness, and called upon us with love and fear, and humbled themselves before us

21:91.t: And her who kept her maidenhood, and into whom we breathed of our spirit, and made her and her son a sign to all creatures

21:92.t: Of a truth, this, your religion, is the one Religion, and I your Lord; therefore serve me

21:93.t: But they have rent asunder this their great concern among themselves into sects. All of them shall return to us

21:94.t: And whoso shall do the things that are right, and be a believer, his efforts shall not be disowned: and surely will we write them down for him

21:95.t: There is a ban on every city which we shall have destroyed, that they shall not rise again

21:96.t: Until a way is opened for Gog and Magog, and they shall hasten from every high land

21:97.t: And this sure promise shall draw on. And lo! the eyes of the infidels shall stare amazedly; and they shall say, "Oh, our misery! of this were we careless! yea, we were impious persons

21:98.t: Verily, ye, and what ye worship beside God, shall be fuel for hell: ye shall go down into it

21:99.t: Were these gods, they would not go down into it; but they shall all abide in it for ever

21:100.t: Therein shall they groan; but nought therein shall they hear to comfort them

21:101.t: But they for whom we have before ordained good things, shall be far away from it

21:102.t: Its slightest sound they shall not hear: in what their souls longed for, they shall abide for ever

21:103.t: The great terror shall not trouble them; and the angel shall meet them with, "This is your day which ye were promised

21:104.t: On that day we will roll up the heaven as one rolleth up written scrolls. As we made the first creation, so will we bring it forth again. This promise bindeth us; verily, we will perform it

21:105.t: And now, since the Law was given, have we written in the Psalms that "my servants, the righteous, shall inherit the earth

21:106.t: Verily, in this Koran is teaching for those who serve God

21:107.t: We have not sent thee otherwise than as mercy unto all creatures

21:108.t: SAY: Verily it hath been revealed to me that your God is one God; are ye then resigned to Him?

21:109.t: But if they turn their backs, then SAY: I have warned you all alike; but I know not whether that with which ye are threatened be nigh or distant

21:110.t: God truly knoweth what is spoken aloud, and He also knoweth that which ye hide

21:111.t: And I know not whether haply this delay be not for your trial, and that ye may enjoy yourselves for a time

21:112.t: My Lord saith: Judge ye with truth; for our Lord is the God of Mercy - whose help is to be sought against what ye utter

22:1.t: O MEN of Mecca, fear your Lord. Verily, the earthquake of the last Hour will be a tremendous thing

22:2.t: On the day when ye shall behold it, every suckling woman shall forsake her sucking babe; and every woman that hath a burden in her womb shall cast her burden; and thou shalt see men drunken, yet are they not drunken: but it is the mighty chastisement of God

22:3.t: There is a man who, without knowledge, wrangleth about God, and followeth every rebellious Satan

22:4.t: Concerning whom it is decreed, that he shall surely beguile and guide into the torment of the Flame, whoever shall take him for his Lord

22:5.t: O men! if ye doubt as to the resurrection, yet, of a truth, have We created you of dust, then of the moist germs of life, then of clots of blood, then of pieces of flesh shapen and unshapen, that We might give you proofs of our power! And We cause one sex or the other, at our pleasure, to abide in the womb until the appointed time; then We bring you forth infants; then permit you to reach your age of strength; and one of you dieth, and another of you liveth on to an age so abject that all his former knowledge is clean forgotten! And thou hast seen the earth dried up and barren: but when We send down the rain upon it, it stirreth and swelleth, and groweth every kind of luxuriant herb

22:6.t: This, for that God is the Truth, and that it is He who quickeneth the dead, - and that He hath power over everything

22:7.t: And that "the Hour" will indeed come - there is no doubt of it - and that God will wake up to life those who are in the tombs

22:8.t: A man there is who disputeth about God without knowledge or guidance or enlightening Book

22:9.t: Turning aside in scorn to mislead others from the way of God! Disgrace shall be his in this world; and on the day of the resurrection, We will make him taste the torment of the burning

22:10.t: This, for thy handywork of old! for God is not unjust to His servants

22:11.t: There are some who serve God in a single point. If good come upon one of them, he resteth in it; but if trial come upon him, he turneth him round
with the loss both of this world and of the next! This same is the clear ruin

22:12.t: He calleth upon that beside God which can neither hurt him nor profit him. This same is the far-gone error

22:13.t: He calleth on him who would sooner hurt than profit him. Surely, bad the lord, and, surely, bad the vassal

22:14.t: But God will bring in those who shall believe and do the things that are right, into gardens 'neath which the rivers flow: for God doth that which He pleaseth

22:15.t: Let him who thinketh that God will not help His Apostle in this world and in the next, stretch a cord aloft as if to destroy himself; then let him cut it, and see whether his devices can bring that to nought at which he was angry

22:16.t: Thus send we down the Koran with its clear signs
: and because God guideth whom He pleaseth

22:17.t: As to those who believe, and the Jews, and the Sabeites, and the Christians, and the Magians, and those who join other gods with God, of a truth, God shall decide between them on the day of resurrection: for God is witness of all things

22:18.t: Seest thou not that all in the Heavens and all on the Earth adoreth God? the sun and the moon and the stars, and the mountains, and the trees, and the beasts, and many men? But of many is chastisement the due: And whom God shall disgrace there shall be none to honour: God doth that which pleaseth Him

22:19.t: These, the Faithful and the Infidels, are the two disputants who dispute concerning their Lord: but for those who have disbelieved, garments of fire shall be cut out; the boiling water shall be poured down upon their heads

22:20.t: All that is in their bowels, and their skins, shall be dissolved

22:21.t: and there are maces of iron for them

22:22.t: So oft as they, for very anguish, would fain come forth thence, back shall they be turned into it: and - "Taste ye the torment of the burning

22:23.t: But God will bring in those who shall have believed, and done the things that are right, into gardens 'neath which the rivers flow. Adorned shall they be therein with golden bracelets and with pearls, and their raiment therein shall be of silk

22:24.t: For they were guided to the best of words; guided to the glorious path

22:25.t: But those who believe not, and seduce others from the way of God, and from the Holy Mosque which we have appointed to all men, alike for those who abide therein, and for the stranger; And those who seek impiously to profane it, we will cause to taste a grievous punishment

22:26.t: And call to mind when we assigned the site of the House to Abraham and said: "Unite not aught with Me in worship, and cleanse My House for those who go in procession round it, and who stand or bow in worship

22:27.t: And proclaim to the peoples a PILGRIMAGE: Let them come to thee on foot and on every fleet camel, arriving by every deep defile

22:28.t: That they may bear witness of its benefits to them, and may make mention of God's name on the appointed days, over the brute beasts with which He hath supplied them for sustenance: Therefore eat thereof yourselves, and feed the needy, the poor

22:29.t: Then let them bring the neglect of their persons to a close, and let them pay their vows, and circuit the ancient House

22:30.t: This do. And he that respecteth the sacred ordinances of God, this will be best for him with his Lord. The flesh of cattle is allowed you, save of those already specified to you. Shun ye, therefore, the pollutions of idols; and shun ye the word of falsehood

22:31.t: Sound in faith Godward, uniting no god with Him; for whoever uniteth gods with God, is like that which falleth from on high, and the birds snatch it away, or the wind wafteth it to a distant place

22:32.t: This do. And they who respect the rites of God, perform an action which proceedeth from piety of heart

22:33.t: Ye may obtain advantages from the cattle up to the set time for slaying them: then, the place for sacrificing them is at the ancient House

22:34.t: And to every people have we appointed rites, that they may commemorate the name of God over the brute beasts which He hath provided for them. And your God is the one God. To Him, therefore, surrender yourselves: and bear thou good tidings to those who humble them

22:35.t: Whose hearts, when mention is made of God, thrill with awe; and to those who remain steadfast under all that be-falleth them, and observe prayer, and give alms of that with which we have supplied them

22:36.t: And the camels have we appointed you for the sacrifice to God: much good have ye in them. Make mention, therefore, of the name of God over them when ye slay them, as they stand in a row; and when they are fallen over on their sides, eat of them, and feed him who is content and asketh not, and him who asketh. Thus have We subjected them to you, to the intent ye should be thankful

22:37.t: By no means can their flesh reach unto God, neither their blood; but piety on your part reacheth Him. Thus hath He subjected them to you, that ye might magnify God for His guidance: moreover, announce to those who do good deeds

22:38.t: That God will ward off mischief from believers: for God loveth not the false, the Infidel

22:39.t: A sanction is given to those who, because they have suffered outrages, have taken up arms; and verily, God is well able to succour them

22:40.t: Those who have been driven forth from their homes wrongfully, only because they say "Our Lord is the God." And if God had not repelled some men by others, cloisters, and churches, and oratories, and mosques, wherein the name of God is ever commemorated, would surely have been destroyed. And him who helpeth God will God surely help: for God is right Strong, Mighty

22:41.t: Those who, if we establish them in this land, will observe prayer, and pay the alms of obligation, and enjoin what is right, and forbid what is evil. And the final issue of all things is unto God

22:42.t: Moreover, if they charge thee with imposture, then already, before them, the people of Noah, and Ad and Themoud

22:43.t: and the people of Abraham, and the people of Lot

22:44.t: and the dwellers in Madian, have charged their prophets with imposture! Moses, too, was charged with imposture! And I bore long with the unbelievers; then seize on them: and how great was the change I wrought

22:45.t: And how many cities which had been ungodly, and whose roofs are now laid low in ruin, have We destroyed! And wells have been abandoned and lofty castles

22:46.t: Have they not journeyed through the land? Have they not hearts to understand with, or ears to hear with? It is not that to these sights their eyes are blind, but the hearts in their breasts are blind

22:47.t: And they will bid thee to hasten the chastisement. But God cannot fail His threat. And verily, a day with thy Lord is as a thousand years, as ye reckon them

22:48.t: How many cities have I long borne with, wicked though they were, yet then laid hold on them to chastise them! Unto Me shall all return

22:49.t: SAY: O men! I am only your open warner

22:50.t: And they who believe and do the things that are right, shall have forgiveness and an honourable provision

22:51.t: But those who strive to invalidate our signs shall be inmates of Hell

22:52.t: We have not sent any apostle or prophet before thee, among whose desires Satan injected not some wrong desire, but God shall bring to nought that which Satan had suggested. Thus shall God affirm His revelations for God is Knowing, Wise

22:53.t: That He may make that which Satan hath injected, a trial to those in whose hearts is a disease, and whose hearts are hardened. - Verily, the wicked are in a far-gone severance from the truth

22:54.t: And that they to whom "the Knowledge" hath been given, may know that the Koran is the truth from thy Lord, and may believe in it, and their hearts may acquiesce in it: for God is surely the guider of those who believe, into the straight path
