37:77.t: And we made his offspring the survivors

37:78.t: And we left for him with posterity

37:79.t: Peace be on Noah throughout the worlds

37:80.t: Thus do we reward the well-doers

37:81.t: For he was one of our believing servants

37:83.t: And truly, of his faith was Abraham

37:84.t: When he brought to his Lord a perfect heart

37:85.t: When he said to his father and to his people, "What is this ye worship

37:86.t: Prefer ye with falsehood gods to God

37:87.t: And what deem ye of the Lord of the worlds

37:88.t: So gazing he gazed towards the stars

37:89.t: And said, "In sooth I am ill

37:90.t: And they turned their back on him and departed

37:91.t: He went aside to their gods and said, "Do ye not eat

37:92.t: What aileth you that ye do not speak

37:93.t: He broke out upon them, with the right hand striking

37:94.t: When his tribesmen came back to him with hasty steps

37:95.t: He said, "Worship ye what ye carve

37:96.t: When God hath created you, and that ye make

37:97.t: They said, "Build up a pyre for him and cast him into the glowing flame

37:98.t: Fain would they plot against him, but we brought them low

37:99.t: And he said, "Verily, I repair to my Lord who will guide me

37:100.t: O Lord give me a son, of the righteous

37:101.t: We announced to him a youth of meekness

37:102.t: And when he became a full-grown youth, His father said to him, "My son, I have seen in a dream that I should sacrifice thee; therefore, consider what thou seest right." He said, "My father, do what thou art bidden; of the patient, if God please, shalt thou find me

37:103.t: And when they had surrendered them to the will of God, he laid him down upon his forehead

37:105.t: Now hast thou satisfied the vision." See how we recompense the righteous

37:106.t: This was indeed a decisive test

37:107.t: And we ransomed his son with a costly victim

37:108.t: And we left this for him among posterity

37:110.t: Thus do we reward the well-doers

37:111.t: For he was of our believing servants

37:112.t: And we announced Isaac to him - a righteous Prophet

37:113.t: And on him and on Isaac we bestowed our blessing. And among their offspring were well-doers, and others, to their own hurt undoubted sinners

37:114.t: And of old, to Moses and to Aaron shewed we favours

37:115.t: And both of them, and their people, we rescued from the great distress

37:116.t: And we succoured them, and they became the conquerors

37:118.t: And we guided them each into the right way

37:119.t: And we left this for each among posterity

37:120.t: PEACE BE ON MOSES AND AARON

37:121.t: Thus do we reward the well-doers

37:122.t: For they were two of our believing servants

37:123.t: And Elias truly was of our Sent Ones

37:124.t: When he said to his people, "Fear ye not God

37:125.t: Invoke ye Baal and forsake ye the most skilful Creator

37:126.t: God is your Lord, and the Lord of your sires of old

37:127.t: But they treated him as a liar, and shall therefore be consigned to punishment

37:129.t: And we left this for him among posterity

37:131.t: Thus do we reward the well-doers

37:132.t: For he was one of our believing servants

37:133.t: And Lot truly was of our Sent Ones

37:134.t: When we rescued him and all his family

37:135.t: Save an aged woman among those who tarried

37:137.t: And ye indeed pass by their ruined dwellings at morn

37:138.t: And night: will ye not then reflect

37:139.t: Jonas, too, was one of the Apostles

37:140.t: When he fled unto the laden ship

37:141.t: And lots were cast, and he was doomed

37:142.t: And the fish swallowed him, for he was blameworthy

37:143.t: But had he not been of those who praise Us

37:144.t: In its belly had he surely remained, till the day of resurrection

37:145.t: And we cast him on the bare shore - and he was sick

37:146.t: And we caused a gourd-plant to grow up over him

37:147.t: And we sent him to a hundred thousand persons, or even more

37:148.t: And because they believed, we continued their enjoyments for a season

37:149.t: Inquire then of the Meccans whether thy Lord hath daughters, and they, sons

37:150.t: Have we created the angels females? and did they witness it

37:151.t: Is it not a falsehood of their own devising, when they say

37:152.t: God hath begotten"? They are indeed liars

37:153.t: Would he have preferred daughters to sons

37:154.t: What reason have ye for thus judging

37:155.t: Will ye not then receive this warning

37:156.t: Have ye a clear proof for them

37:157.t: Produce your Book if ye speak truth

37:158.t: And they make him to be of kin with the Djinn: but the Djinn have long known that these idolaters shall be brought up before God

37:159.t: Far be the glory of God from what they impute to him

37:160.t: His faithful servants do not thus

37:161.t: Moreover, ye and what ye worship

37:162.t: Shall not stir up any against God

37:163.t: Save him who shall burn in Hell

37:164.t: And verily each one of us hath his appointed place

37:165.t: And we range ourselves in order

37:168.t: Had we a revelation transmitted to us from those of old

37:169.t: We had surely been God's faithful servants

37:170.t: Yet they believe not the Koran. But they shall know its truth at last

37:171.t: Our word came of old to our servants the apostles

37:172.t: That they should surely be the succoured

37:173.t: And that our armies should procure the victory for them

37:174.t: Turn aside therefore from them for a time

37:175.t: And behold them, for they too shall in the end behold their doom

37:176.t: Would they then hasten our vengeance

37:177.t: But when it shall come down into their courts, an evil morning shall it be to those who have had their warning

37:178.t: Turn aside from them therefore for a time

37:179.t: And behold; for they too shall in the end behold their doom

37:180.t: Far be the glory of thy Lord, the Lord of all greatness, from what they impute to him

37:181.t: And peace be on his Apostles

37:182.t: And praise be to God the Lord of the worlds

38:1.t: SAD. By the Koran full of warning

38:2.t: In sooth the Infidels are absorbed in pride, in contention with thee

38:3.t: How many generations have we destroyed before them! And they cried for mercy but no time was it of escape

38:4.t: And they marvel that a warner from among themselves hath come to them; and the Infidels say, "This is a sorcerer, a liar

38:5.t: Maketh he the gods to be but one god? A strange thing forsooth is this

38:6.t: And their chiefs took themselves off. "Go, said they, and cleave steadfastly to your gods. Ye see the thing aimed at

38:7.t: We heard not of this in the previous creed. It is but an imposture

38:8.t: To him alone of us all hath a book of warning been sent down?" Yes! they are in doubt as to my warnings, for they have not yet tasted my vengeance

38:9.t: Are the treasures of the mercy of thy Lord, the Mighty, the bounteous, in their hands

38:10.t: Is the kingdom of the heavens and of the earth and of all that is between them theirs? Then let them mount up by cords

38:11.t: Any army of the confederates shall here be routed

38:12.t: Before them the people of Noah and Ad and Pharaoh the impaler treated their prophets as impostors

38:13.t: And Themoud, and the people of Lot, and the dwellers in the forest: these were the confederates

38:14.t: Nought did they all but charge the apostles with falsehood: Just, therefore, the retribution

38:15.t: await but one single trumpet blast - There shall be no delaying it

38:16.t: Yet they dare to say, "O our Lord! hasten our lot to us, before the day of reckoning

38:17.t: Put thou up with what they say: and remember our servant David, a man strong of hand, one who turned him to Us in penitence

38:18.t: We constrained the mountains to join with him in lauds at even and at sunrise

38:19.t: And the birds which flocked to him, and would all return to him oft

38:20.t: And we stablished his kingdom: and wisdom, and skill to pronounce clear decisions, did we bestow on him

38:21.t: Hath the story of the two pleaders reached thee, O Muhammad, when they mounted the walls of his closet

38:22.t: When they entered in upon David, and he was frightened at them, they said, "Be not afraid; we are two opposing parties: one of us hath wronged the other. Judge therefore with truth between us, and be not unjust, but guide us to the right way

38:23.t: Now this my brother had ninety and nine ewes, and I had but a single ewe; and he said, make me her keeper. And he over-persuaded me in the dispute

38:24.t: He said, "Certainly he hath wronged thee in asking for thine ewe to add her to his own ewes: and truly many associates do one another wrong - except those who believe and do the things that are right; and few indeed are they!" And David perceived that we had tried him; so he asked pardon of his Lord, and fell down and bowed himself and repented

38:25.t: So we forgave him that his sin; and truly he shall have a high rank with Us, and an excellent retreat in Paradise

38:26.t: O David! verily we have made thee our vicegerent upon earth. Judge therefore between men with truth, and follow not thy passions, lest they cause thee to err from the way of God. For they who err from the way of God shall meet with a grievous chastisement, for that they have forgotten the day of reckoning

38:27.t: We have not created the heaven and the earth and what is between them for nought. That is the thought of infidels; but woe to the infidels because of the fire

38:28.t: Shall we treat those who believe and do the things that are right like those who propagate evil on earth? Shall we treat the God-fearing like the impious

38:29.t: A blessed Book have we sent down to thee, that men may meditate its verses, and that those endued with understanding may bear it in mind

38:30.t: And Solomon gave we unto David. An excellent servant, for he loved to turn him Godward

38:31.t: Remember when at eventide the prancing chargers were displayed before him

38:32.t: And he said, "Truly I have loved the love of earthly goods above the remembrance of my Lord, till the sun hath been hidden by the veil of darkness

38:33.t: Bring them back to me." And he began to sever the legs and necks

38:34.t: We also made trial of Solomon, and placed a phantom on his throne: whereupon he returned to Us

38:35.t: He said, O my Lord! pardon me, and give me a dominion that may not be to any one beside me, for thou art the liberal giver

38:36.t: So we subjected the wind to him; it ran softly at his bidding, whithersoever he directed it

38:37.t: And the Satans - every builder and diver

38:39.t: This," said we, "is our gift: be bounteous then, or withhold thy favours; no account shalt thou render

38:40.t: And his rank also is high with Us, and an excellent retreat

38:41.t: And remember our servant Job when he cried to his Lord, "Verily, Satan hath laid on me disease and pain

38:42.t: Stamp," said we, "with thy foot. This is to wash with; cool, and to drink

38:43.t: And we gave him back his family, and as many more with them in our mercy; and for a monition to men of judgment

38:44.t: And we said, "Take in thine hand a rod, and strike with it, nor break thine oath." Verily, we found him patient! How excellent a servant, one who turned to Us was he

38:45.t: And remember our servants Abraham and Isaac and Jacob, men of might and vision

38:46.t: With this cleansing did we cleanse them the remembrance of the abode of Paradise

38:47.t: And verily, they were, in our sight, of the elect and of the good

38:48.t: And remember Ishmael and Elisha and Dhoulkefl, for all these were of the just

38:49.t: This is a monition: and verily, the pious shall have a goodly retreat

38:50.t: Gardens of Eden, whose portals shall stand open to them

38:51.t: Therein reclining, they shall there call for many a fruit and drink

38:52.t: And with them shall be virgins of their own age, with modest retiring glances

38:53.t: This is what ye were promised at the day of reckoning

38:54.t: Yes! this is our provision: it shall never fail

38:55.t: Even so. But for the evil doers is a wretched home

38:56.t: Hell - wherein they shall be burned: how wretched a bed

38:57.t: Even so. Let them then taste it - boiling water and gore

38:58.t: And other things of kindred sort

38:59.t: To their leaders it shall be said, "This company shall be thrown in headlong with you. No greetings shall await them, for they shall be burned in the fire

38:60.t: They shall say: "But ye, too! there shall be no welcome for you. It was ye who prepared this for us, and wretched is the abode

38:61.t: They will say: "O our Lord! increase twofold in the fire, the punishment of him who hath brought this upon us

38:62.t: And they will say: "Why see we not the men whom we numbered among the wicked

38:63.t: Whom we used to treat with scorn? Have they escaped our eyes

38:64.t: Verily this is truth - the wrangling together of the people of the fire

38:65.t: SAY: I am but a warner; and there is no God but God the One, the Almighty

38:66.t: Lord of the Heavens and of the Earth, and of all that is between them, the Potent, the Forgiving

38:67.t: SAY: this is a weighty message

38:69.t: Yet had I no knowledge of what passed among the celestial chiefs when they disputed

38:70.t: Verily, it hath been revealed to me only because I am a public preacher

38:71.t: When thy Lord said to the angels, "I am about to make man of clay

38:72.t: And when I have formed him and breathed my spirit into him, then worshipping fall down before him

38:73.t: And the angels prostrated themselves, all of them with one accord

38:74.t: Save Eblis. He swelled with pride, and became an unbeliever

38:75.t: O Eblis," said God, "what hindereth thee from prostrating thyself before him whom my hands have made? Is it that thou are puffed up with pride? or art thou a being of lofty merit

38:76.t: He said: "I am more excellent than he; me hast thou created of fire: of clay hast thou created him

38:77.t: He said: "Begone then hence: thou art accursed

38:78.t: And lo! my ban shall be on thee till the day of the reckoning

38:79.t: He said: "O my Lord! respite me till the day of Resurrection

38:80.t: He said, "One then of the respited shalt thou be

38:81.t: Till the day of the time appointed

38:82.t: He said: "I swear by thy might then that all of them will I seduce

38:83.t: Save thy sincere servants among them

38:84.t: He said: "It is truth, and the truth I speak

38:85.t: From thee will I surely fill Hell, and with such of them as shall follow thee, one and all

38:86.t: Say: I ask no wage of you for this, nor am I one who intermeddleth

38:87.t: Of a truth the Koran is no other than a warning to all creatures

38:88.t: And after a time shall ye surely know its message

39:1.t: THE Book sent down from God, the Mighty, the Wise

39:2.t: We have sent down the Book to thee with the truth: serve thou God then, and be sincere in thy worship

39:3.t: Is not a sincere worship due to God? But they who take others beside him as lords saying, "We serve them only that they may bring us near to God" - God will judge between them and the faithful, concerning that wherein they are at variance. Verily God will not guide him who is a liar, an infidel

39:4.t: Had God desired to have had a son, he had surely chosen what he pleased out of his own creation. But praise be to Him! He is God, the One, the Almighty

39:5.t: For truth hath he created the Heavens and the Earth: It is of Him that the night returneth upon the day and that the day returneth upon the night: and He controlleth the sun and the moon so that each speedeth to an appointed goal. Is He not the Mighty, the Gracious

39:6.t: He created you all of one man, from whom He afterwards formed his wife; and of cattle He hath sent down to you four pairs. In the wombs of your mothers did He create you by creation upon creation in triple darkness. It is He who is God your Lord: the kingdom is His: There is no God but He. How then are ye so turned aside from Him

39:7.t: Suppose ye render him no thanks! yet forsooth is God rich without you: but He is not pleased with thanklessness in His servants: yet if ye be thankful He will be pleased with you. The soul burdened with its own works shall not be burdened with the burden of another: hereafter shall ye return to your Lord, and he will tell you of all your works, For he knoweth the very secrets of your breasts

39:8.t: When some trouble toucheth a man, he turneth to his Lord and calleth on him: yet no sooner hath He enriched him with his favour than he forgetteth Him on whom he before had called, and setteth up peers with God, that he may beguile others from His way. SAY: Enjoy thou thyself yet a little in thine ingratitude! but thou shalt surely be one of the inmates of the fire

39:9.t: Shall he who observeth the hours of the night, prostrate or standing in devotion, heedful of the life to come, and hoping for the mercy of his Lord...? SAY: Shall they who have knowledge and they who have it not, be treated alike? In sooth, men of understanding only will take the warning

39:10.t: SAY: O my believing servants, fear your Lord. For those who do good in this world there is good: and broad is God's earth - verily those who endure with patience shall be repaid: their reward shall not be by measure

39:11.t: SAY: I am bidden to serve God with a sincere worship

39:12.t: and I am bidden to be the first of those who surrender themselves to him

39:13.t: SAY: Verily I fear if I rebel against my Lord the punishment of a great day

39:14.t: SAY: God will I serve, presenting him with a sincere worship

39:15.t: And serve ye what ye choose beside Him. SAY: The losers truly will they be who shall lose their own souls and their families on the day of resurrection: Is not this the clear ruin

39:16.t: Canopies of fire shall be over them, and floors of fire beneath them. With this doth God alarm his servants: Fear ye me, then, O my servants

39:17.t: But good tidings are there for those who shun the worship of Thagout and are turned to God. Cheer then with good tidings those my servants

39:18.t: who hearken to my word and follow its excellence. These are they whom God guideth, and these are men of insight

39:19.t: Him then on whom the sentence of punishment hath justly lighted - him who is doomed to the fire canst thou rescue

39:20.t: But for those who fear their Lord are storied pavilions beneath which shall the rivers flow: it is the promise of God, and God will not fail in his promise

39:21.t: Seest thou not that God sendeth down water from heaven, and guideth it along so as to form springs in the earth - then bringeth forth by it corn of varied sorts - then causeth he it to wither, and thou seest it become yellow - then crumbleth it away? Lo! herein is teaching for men of insight

39:22.t: Shall he then whose breast God hath opened to Islam, and who hath light from his Lord...? But woe to those whose hearts are hardened against the remembrance of God! They plainly err

39:23.t: The best of recitals hath God sent down a book in unison with itself, and teaching by iteration. The very skins of those who fear their Lord do creep at it! Then do their skins and their hearts soften at the remembrance of their Lord! This is God's guidance: by it will He guide whom He pleaseth; and, whom God shall mislead, no guide shall there be for him

39:24.t: Shall he who shall have nought but his own face to shelter him with from the torment of the punishment on the day of the resurrection...? Aye, to the evil doers it shall be said, "Taste what ye have earned

39:25.t: They who were before them said it was a lie; but a punishment came upon them whence they looked not for it

39:26.t: And God made them taste humiliation in this present life: but greater surely will be the punishment of the life to come. Did they but know it

39:27.t: Now have we set before man in this Koran every kind of parable for their warning

39:28.t: An Arabic Koran, free from tortuous wording, to the intent that they may fear God

39:29.t: God setteth forth the comparison of a man with associates at variance among themselves, and of a man devoted wholly to a man. Are these to be held alike? No, praise be to God! But the greater part of them understand not

39:30.t: Thou truly shall die, O Muhammad, and they too shall die

39:31.t: Then, at the day of resurrection, ye shall wrangle with one another in the presence of your Lord

39:32.t: And who acteth more unjustly than he who lieth of God, and treateth the truth when it cometh to him as a lie? Is there not a dwelling-place in Hell for the infidels

39:33.t: But he who bringeth the truth, and he who believeth it to be the truth: these are the God-fearing

39:34.t: Whatever they shall desire, awaiteth them with their Lord! This is the reward of the righteous

39:35.t: That God may do away the guilt of their worst actions, and for their best actions render them their reward

39:36.t: Is not God all-sufficient for his servant? Yet would they scare thee by their idols. But no guide shall there be for him whom God misleadeth

39:37.t: And he whom God guideth shall have none to mislead him. Is not God, all-mighty, able to revenge

39:38.t: And if thou ask them who hath created the Heavens and the Earth, they will surely answer, God. SAY: Think ye, then, that they on whom ye call beside God, if God choose to afflict me, could remove his affliction? or if he choose to show me mercy, could they withhold His mercy? SAY: God sufficeth me: in Him let the trusting trust

39:39.t: SAY: O my people, act your part as best ye can, I too will act mine; and in the end ye shall know

39:40.t: On whom shall light a punishment that shall shame him, and on whom a lasting punishment shall fall

39:41.t: Assuredly we have sent down the Book to thee for man and for the ends of truth. Whoso shall be guided by it - it will be for his own advantage, and whoso shall err, shall only err to his own loss. But not to thy keeping are they entrusted

39:42.t: God taketh souls unto Himself at death; and during their sleep those who do not die: and he retaineth those on which he hath passed a decree of death, but sendeth the others back till a time that is fixed. Herein are signs for the reflecting

39:43.t: Have they taken aught beside God as intercessors? SAY: What! though they have no power over anything, neither do they understand

39:44.t: SAY: Intercession is wholly with God: His the kingdom of the Heavens and of the Earth! To him shall ye be brought back hereafter

39:45.t: But when the One God is named, the hearts of those who believe not in the life to come, shrivel up: but when the deities who are adored beside Him are named, lo! they are filled with joy

39:46.t: SAY: O God, creator of the Heaven and of the Earth, who knowest the hidden and the manifest, thou shalt judge between thy servants as to the subject of their disputes

39:47.t: If the wicked possessed all that is in the earth and as much again therewith, verily they would ransom themselves with it from the pain of the punishment on the day of the resurrection; and there shall appear to them, from God, things they had never reckoned on

39:48.t: And their own ill deeds shall be clearly perceived by them, and that fire at which they mocked shall encircle them on every side

39:49.t: When trouble befalleth a man he crieth to Us; afterwards, when we have vouchsafed favour to him, he saith, "God knew that I deserved it." Nay, it is a trial. But the greater part of them knew it not

39:50.t: The same said those who flourished before them; but their deeds profited them not

39:51.t: And their own ill deeds recoiled upon them. And whoso among these
shall do wrong, on them likewise their own misdeeds shall light, neither shall they invalidate God

39:52.t: Know they not that God giveth supplies with open hand, and that He is sparing to whom He will? Of a truth herein are signs to those who believe

39:53.t: SAY: O my servants who have transgressed to your own hurt, despair not of God's mercy, for all sins doth God forgive. Gracious, Merciful is He

39:54.t: And return ye to your Lord, and to Him resign yourselves, ere the punishment come on you, for then ye shall not be helped

39:55.t: And follow that most excellent thing which hath been sent down to you from your Lord, ere the punishment come on you suddenly, and when ye look not for it

39:56.t: So that a soul say, "Oh misery! for my failures in duty towards God! and verily I was of those who scoffed

39:57.t: Or say, "Had God guided me, I had surely been of those who feared Him

39:58.t: Or say, when it seeth the punishment, "Could I but return, then I would be of the righteous

39:59.t: Nay! my signs had already come to thee, and thou didst treat them as untruths, and wast arrogant, and becamest of those who believed not

39:60.t: And on the resurrection day, thou shalt see those who have lied of God, with their faces black. Is there not an abode in Hell for the arrogant

39:61.t: But God shall rescue those who fear him into their safe retreat: no ill shall touch them, neither shall they be put to grief

39:62.t: God is the creator of all things, and of all things is He the guardian

39:63.t: His the keys of the Heavens and of the Earth! and - who believe not in the signs of God - these! they shall perish

39:64.t: SAY: What! do ye then bid me worship other than God, O ye ignorant ones

39:65.t: But now hath it been revealed to thee and to those who flourished before thee, - "Verily, if thou join partners with God, vain shall be all thy work, and thyself shalt be of those who perish

39:66.t: Nay, rather worship God! and be of those who render thanks

39:67.t: But they have not deemed of God as is His due; for on the resurrection day the whole Earth shall be but his handful, and in his right hand shall the Heavens be folded together. Praise be to Him! and high be He uplifted above the partners they join with Him

39:68.t: And there shall be a blast on the trumpet, and all who are in the Heavens and all who are in the Earth shall expire, save those whom God shall vouchsafe to live. Then shall there be another blast on it, and lo! arising they shall gaze around them

39:69.t: And the earth shall shine with the light of her Lord, and the Book shall be set, and the prophets shall be brought up, and the witnesses; and judgment shall be given between them with equity; and none shall be wronged

39:70.t: And every soul shall receive as it shall have wrought, for well knoweth He men's actions

39:71.t: And by TROOPS shall the unbelievers be driven towards Hell, until when they reach it, its gates shall be opened, and its keepers shall say to them, "Came not apostles from among yourselves to you, reciting to you the signs of your Lord, and warning you of the meeting with Him on this your day?" They shall say, "Yes." But just is the sentence of punishment on the unbelievers

39:72.t: It shall be said to them, "Enter ye the gates of Hell, therein to dwell for ever;" and wretched the abode of the arrogant

39:73.t: But those who feared their Lord shall be driven on by troops to Paradise, until when they reach it, its gates shall be opened, and its keepers shall say to them, "All hail! virtuous have ye been: enter then in, to abide herein for ever

39:74.t: And they shall say, "Praise be to God, who hath made good to us His promise, and hath given to us the earth as our heritage, that we may dwell in Paradise wherever we please!" And goodly is the reward of those who travailed virtuously

39:75.t: And thou shalt see the Angels circling around the Throne with praises of their Lord: and judgment shall be pronounced between them with equity: and it shall be said, "Glory be to God the Lord of the Worlds

40:2.t: of the Book is from God the Almighty, the All-knowing

40:3.t: Forgiver of sin, and receiver of penitence, - vehement in chastisement, Long-suffering! There is no God but He: to Him shall be the final gathering

40:4.t: None but infidels gainsay the signs of God: but let not their prosperity in the land deceive thee

40:5.t: The people of Noah, and the confederates after them, have brought the charge of imposture before these Meccans: each nation schemed against their apostle to lay violent hold on him, and disputed with vain words to refute the truth. Therefore did I lay violent hold on them; and how great was my chastisement

40:6.t: Thus is it that thy Lord's sentence, that inmates shall they be of the fire, was accomplished upon the infidels

40:7.t: They who bear the throne and they who encircle it, celebrate the praise of their Lord and believe in Him, and implore forgiveness for the believers: - "O our Lord! thou embracest all things in mercy and knowledge; forgive, therefore, those who turn to thee and follow thy path; keep them from the pains of hell

40:8.t: O our Lord! and bring them into the Gardens of Eden which thou hast promised to them, and to the righteous ones of their fathers and their wives and their children; for thou art the All-mighty, the All-wise

40:9.t: And keep them from evil: for on him hast thou mercy whom on that day thou shalt keep from evil;" and this will be the great felicity

40:10.t: But to the infidels shall a voice cry, "Surely the hatred of God is more grievous than your hatred of yourselves, when ye were called to the faith, and remained unbelievers

40:11.t: They shall say, "Twice, O our Lord, hast thou given us death, and twice hast thou given us life: and we acknowledge our sins: is there no way to escape

40:12.t: This hath befallen you, for that when One God was proclaimed to you, ye believed not: but when partners had been united with him, ye believed: But judgment belongeth unto God, the High, the Great

40:13.t: It is He who sheweth you his signs, and sendeth down supplies to you from Heaven: but none will receive warning save he who turneth to God

40:14.t: Call then on God, offering him a pure worship, though the infidels abhor it

40:15.t: Of exalted grade, of the throne possessed, He sendeth forth the Spirit at His own behest on whomsoever of His servants He pleaseth, that He may warn of the day of meeting

40:16.t: The day when they shall come forth from their graves, when nought that concerneth them shall be hidden from God. With whom shall be the power supreme on that day? With God, the One, the Almighty

40:17.t: On that day shall every soul be recompensed as it hath deserved: no injustice on that day! Verily, God will be swift to reckon

40:18.t: Warn them, then, of the approaching day, when men's hearts shall rise up, choking them, into their throats. The evil-doers shall have no friend or intercessor who shall prevail

40:19.t: God knoweth the deceitful of eye, and what men's breasts conceal

40:20.t: And everything will God decide with truth: But nothing shall those gods whom men call on beside him, decide. Verily, God! the Hearer, the Beholder, He

40:21.t: Have they never journeyed in this land, and seen what hath been the end of those who flourished before them? Mightier were they in strength than these Meccans, and their traces remain in the land: Yet God took them in their sins, and there was none to defend them against God

40:22.t: This, because their apostles had come to them with proofs of their mission, and they believed not: so God took them in hand; for He is mighty, vehement in punishing

40:23.t: Moreover we had sent Moses of old with our signs and with clear authority

40:24.t: To Pharaoh, and Haman, and Karun: and they said, "Sorcerer, impostor

40:25.t: And when he came to them from our presence with the truth, they said, "Slay the sons of those who believe as he doth, and save their females alive;" but the stratagem of the unbelievers issued only in failure

40:26.t: And Pharaoh said, "Let me alone, that I may kill Moses; and let him call upon his Lord: I fear lest he change your religion, or cause disorder to shew itself in the land

40:27.t: And Moses said, "I take refuge with my Lord and your Lord from every proud one who believeth not in the day of reckoning

40:28.t: And a man of the family of Pharaoh, who was a BELIEVER, but hid his faith, said, "Will ye slay a man because he saith my Lord is God, when he hath already come to you with proofs of his mission from your Lord? and if he be a liar, on him will be his lie: but if he be a man of truth, part at least of what he threateneth will fall upon you. Truly God guideth not him who is a transgressor, a liar

40:29.t: O my people! this day is the kingdom yours, the eminent of the earth! but who shall defend us from the vengeance of God if it come on us?" Pharaoh said, "I would have you see only what I see; and in a right way only will I guide you

40:30.t: Then said he who believed, "O my people! truly I fear for you the like of the day of the allies

40:31.t: The like of the state of the people of Noah and Ad and Themoud, And of those who came after them; yet God willeth not injustice to his servants

40:32.t: And, O my people! I indeed fear for you the day of mutual outcry

40:33.t: The day when ye shall be turned back from the Judgment into hell. No protector shall ye have then against God. And he whom God shall mislead no guide shall there be for him

40:34.t: Moreover, Joseph had come to you before with clear tokens, but ye ceased not to doubt of the message with which he came to you, until when he died, ye said, 'God will by no means raise up an apostle after him.' " Thus God misleadeth him who is the transgressor, the doubter

40:35.t: They who gainsay the signs of God without authority having come to them, are greatly hated by God and by those who believe. Thus God sealeth up every proud, contumacious heart

40:36.t: And Pharaoh said, "O Haman, Build for me a tower that I may reach the avenues

40:37.t: The avenues of the heavens, and may mount to the God of Moses, for I verily deem him a liar." And thus the evil of his doings was made fair-seeming to Pharaoh, and he turned away from the path of truth; but the artifice of Pharaoh ended only in his ruin

40:38.t: And he who believed said, "O my people! follow me: into the right way will I guide you

40:39.t: O my people! this present life is only a passing joy, but the life to come is the mansion that abideth

40:40.t: Whoso shall have wrought evil shall not be recompensed but with its like; but whoso shall have done the things that are right, whether male or female, and is a believer - these shall enter paradise: good things unreckoned shall they enjoy therein

40:41.t: And, O my people! how is it that I bid you to salvation, but that ye bid me to the fire

40:42.t: Ye invite me to deny God, and to join with him gods of whom I know nothing; but I invite you to the Mighty, the Forgiving

40:43.t: No doubt is there that they to whom ye invite me are not to be invoked either in this world or in the world to come: and that unto God is our return, and that the transgressors shall be the inmates of the fire

40:44.t: Then shall ye remember what I am saying unto you: and to God commit I my case: Verily, God beholdeth his servants

40:45.t: So God preserved him from the evils which they had planned, and the woe of the punishment encompassed the people of Pharaoh

40:46.t: It is the fire to which they shall be exposed morning and evening, and on the day when "the Hour" shall arrive - "Bring in the people of Pharaoh into the severest punishment

40:47.t: And when they shall wrangle together in the fire, the weak shall say to those who had borne themselves so proudly, "It is you we followed: will ye therefore relieve us from aught of the fire

40:48.t: And those proud ones shall say, "Verily we are all in it; for now hath God judged between his servants

40:49.t: And they who are in the fire shall say to the keepers of Hell, "Implore your Lord that he would give us ease but for one day from this torment

40:50.t: They shall say, "Came not your apostles to you with the tokens?" They shall say, "Yes." They shall say, "Cry ye then aloud for help:" but the cry of the unbelievers shall be only in vain

40:51.t: Assuredly, in this present life will we succour our apostles and those who shall have believed, and on the day when the witnesses shall stand forth

40:52.t: A day whereon the plea of the evil doers shall not avail them; but theirs shall be a curse, and theirs the woe of the abode in Hell

40:53.t: And of old gave we Moses the guidance, and we made the children of Israel the heritors of the Book

40:54.t: a guidance and warning to men endued with understanding

40:55.t: Therefore be steadfast thou and patient; for true is the promise of God: and seek pardon for thy fault, and celebrate the praise of thy Lord at evening and at morning

40:56.t: As to those who cavil at the signs of God without authority having reached them, nought is there but pride in their breasts: but they shall not succeed. Fly thou for refuge then to God, for He is the Hearer, the Beholder

40:57.t: Greater surely than the creation of man is the creation of the heavens and of the earth: but most men know it not

40:58.t: Moreover, the blind and the seeing, and the evil doer and they who believe and do the things that are right, shall not be deemed equal. How few ponder this

40:59.t: Aye, "the Hour" will surely come: there is no doubt of it: but most men believe it not

40:60.t: And your Lord saith, "Call upon me - I will hearken unto you: but they who turn in disdain from my service shall enter Hell with shame

40:61.t: It is God who hath ordained the night for your rest, and the day to give you light: verily God is rich in bounties to men: but most men render not the tribute of thanks

40:62.t: This is God your Lord, Creator of all things: no god is there but He: why then do ye turn away from Him

40:63.t: Yet thus are they turned aside who gainsay the signs of God

40:64.t: It is God who hath given you the earth as a sure foundation, and over it built up the Heaven, and formed you, and made your forms beautiful, and feedeth you with good things. This is God your Lord. Blessed then be God the Lord of the Worlds

40:65.t: He is the Living One. No God is there but He. Call then upon Him and offer Him a pure worship. Praise be to God the Lord of the Worlds

40:66.t: SAY: Verily I am forbidden to worship what ye call on beside God, after that the clear tokens have come to me from my Lord, and I am bidden to surrender myself to the Lord of the Worlds

40:67.t: He it is who created you of the dust, then of the germs of life, then of thick blood, then brought you forth infants: then he letteth you reach your full strength, and then become old men
but some of you die first
, and reach the ordained term. And this that haply ye may understand

40:68.t: It is He who giveth life and death; and when He decreeth a thing, He only saith of it, "Be," and it is

40:69.t: Seest thou not those who cavil at the signs of God? how are they turned aside

40:70.t: They who treat "the Book," and the message with which we have sent our Sent Ones, as a lie, shall know the truth hereafter

40:71.t: When the collars shall be on their necks and the chains to drag them

40:72.t: into Hell: then in the fire shall they be burned

40:73.t: Then shall it be said to them, "Where are they whom ye made the objects of joint worship with God

40:74.t: They shall say, "They have vanished away from us. Yea, it was nought on which we called heretofore." Thus God leadeth the unbelievers astray

40:75.t: This for you, because of your unrighteous insolence and immoderate joys on earth

40:76.t: Enter ye the portals of Hell to abide therein for ever. And, wretched the abode of the haughty ones

40:77.t: Therefore be thou steadfast in patience: for the promise of God is truth: and whether we shall make thee see part of the woes with which we threatened them, or whether we cause thee first to die, unto us shall they be brought back

40:78.t: And we have already sent apostles before thee: of some we have told thee, and of others we have told thee nothing: but no apostle had the power to work a miracle unless by the leave of God. But when God's behest cometh, everything will be decided with truth: and then they perish who treated it as a vain thing

40:79.t: It is God who hath given you the cattle that on some of them ye may ride, and of some may eat

40:80.t: Other advantages too do ye derive from them
- and that by them ye may effect the projects ye cherish in your breasts; for on them, and on ships are ye borne

40:81.t: And He sheweth you His signs: which, then, of the signs of God will ye deny

40:82.t: Have they not journeyed in this land, and seen what hath been the end of those who flourished before them? More were they than these in number and mightier in strength, and greater are the traces of their power remaining in the land: yet their labours availed them nothing

40:83.t: And when their apostles had come to them with the tokens of their mission, they exulted in what they possessed of knowledge; but that retribution at which they scoffed, encompassed them

40:84.t: And when they beheld our vengeance they said, "We believe in God alone, and we disbelieve in the deities we once associated with Him

40:85.t: But their faith, after they had witnessed our vengeance, profited them not. Such the procedure of God with regard to his servants who flourished of old. And then the unbelievers perished

41:2.t: A Revelation from the Compassionate, the Merciful

41:3.t: are MADE PLAIN - an Arabic Koran, for men of knowledge

41:4.t: Announcer of glad tidings and charged with warnings! But most of them withdraw and hearken not

41:5.t: And they say, "Our hearts are under shelter from thy teachings, and in our ears is a deafness, and between us and thee there is a veil. Act as thou thinkest right: we verily shall act as we think right

41:6.t: SAY: I am only a man like you. It is revealed to me that your God is one God: go straight then to Him, and implore his pardon. And woe to those who join gods with God

41:7.t: Who pay not the alms of obligation, and in the life to come believe not

41:8.t: But they who believe and do the things that are right shall receive a perfect recompense

41:9.t: SAY: Do ye indeed disbelieve in Him who in two days created the earth? and do ye assign Him peers? The Lord of the worlds is He

41:10.t: And he hath placed on the earth the firm mountains which tower above it; and He hath blessed it, and distributed food throughout it, for the cravings of all alike, in four days

41:11.t: Then He applied himself to the Heaven, which then was but smoke: and to it and to the Earth He said, "Come ye, whether in obedience or against your will?" and they both said, "We come obedient

41:12.t: And He made them seven heavens in two days, and in each heaven made known its office: And we furnished the lower heaven with lights and guardian angels. This, the disposition of the Almighty, the All-knowing

41:13.t: If they turn away, then SAY: I warn you of a tempest, like the tempest of Ad and Themoud

41:14.t: When the apostles came to them on every side, saying, "Worship none but God," they said, "Had our Lord been pleased to send down, He had surely sent down angels; and in sooth, your message we do not believe

41:15.t: As to Ad, they bore them proudly and unjustly in the land, and said, "Who more mighty than we in prowess?" Saw they not that God their creator was mightier than they in prowess? And they rejected our signs

41:16.t: Therefore on ill-omened days did we send against them an impetuous blast that we might make them taste the chastisement of shame in this world: - but more shameful shall be the chastisement of the life to come; and they shall not be protected

41:17.t: And as to Themoud, we had vouchsafed them guidance; but to guidance did they prefer blindness; wherefore the tempest of a shameful punishment overtook them for their doings

41:18.t: But we rescued the believing and the God-fearing

41:19.t: And warn of the day when the enemies of God shall be gathered unto the fire urged on in bands

41:20.t: Until when they reach it, their ears and their eyes and their skins shall bear witness against them of their deeds

41:21.t: And they shall say to their skins, "Why witness ye against us?" They shall say, "God, who giveth a voice to all things, hath given us a voice: He created you at first, and to Him are ye brought back

41:22.t: And ye did not hide yourselves so that neither your ears nor your eyes nor your skins should witness against you: but ye thought that God knew not many a thing that ye did

41:23.t: And this your thought which ye did think of your Lord hath ruined you, so that ye are become of those who perish

41:24.t: And be they patient, still the fire shall be their abode: or if they beg for favour, yet shall they not be of favoured

41:25.t: And we will appoint Satans as their fast companions; for it was they who made their present and future state seem fair and right to them; and the sentence passed on the peoples of Djinn and men who flourished before them hath become their due, and they shall perish

41:26.t: Yet the unbelievers say, "Hearken not to this Koran, but keep up a talking, that ye may overpower the voice of the reader

41:27.t: Surely therefore will we cause the unbelievers to taste a terrible punishment; And recompense them according to the worst of their actions

41:28.t: This the reward of the enemies of God, - the Fire! it shall be their eternal abode, in requital for their gainsaying our signs

41:29.t: And they who believed not shall say, "O our Lord! shew us those of the Djinn and men who led us astray: both of them will we put under out feet, that they may be of the humbled

41:30.t: But as for those who say, "Our Lord is God;" and who go straight to Him, angels shall descend to them and say, "Fear ye not, neither be ye grieved, but rejoice ye in the paradise which ye have been promised

41:31.t: We are your guardians in this life and in the next: your's therein shall be your soul's desire, and your's therein whatever ye shall ask for

41:32.t: The hospitality of a Gracious, a Merciful One

41:33.t: And who speaketh fairer than he who biddeth to God and doth the thing that is right, and saith, "I for my part am of the Muslims

41:34.t: Moreover, good and evil are not to be treated as the same thing. Turn away evil by what is better, and lo! he between whom and thyself was enmity, shall be as though he were a warm friend

41:35.t: But none attain to this save men steadfast in patience, and none attain to it except the most highly favoured

41:36.t: And if an enticement from Satan entice thee, then take refuge in God, for He is the Hearing, the Knowing

41:37.t: And among his signs are the night, and the day, and the sun, and the moon. Bend not in adoration to the sun or the moon, but bend in adoration before God who created them both, if ye would serve Him

41:38.t: But if they are too proud for this, yet they who are with thy Lord do celebrate His praises night and day, and cease not

41:39.t: And among His signs is this, that thou seest the earth drooping: but, when we send down the rain upon it, it is stirred and swelleth; verily He who giveth it life, will surely give life to the dead; for His might extendeth over all things

41:40.t: They truly who with obloquy disown our signs are not hidden from us. Is he then who shall be cast into the fire, or he who shall come forth secure on the day of resurrection, in the better position? Do what ye will: but His eye is on all your doings

41:41.t: Verily, they who believe not in "the warning," after it hath come to them... and yet the Koran is a glorious book

41:42.t: Falsehood, from whatever side it cometh, shall not come night it; it is a missive down from the Wise, the Praiseworthy

41:43.t: Nothing hath been said to thee which hath not been said of old to apostles before thee. Verily with thy Lord is forgiveness, and with Him is terrible retribution

41:44.t: Had we made it a Koran in a foreign tongue, they had surely said, "Unless its signs be made clear...! What! in a foreign tongue? and the people Arabian?" SAY: It is to those who believe a guide and a medicine; but as to those who believe not, there is a thickness in their ears, and to them it is a blindness: they are like those who are called to from afar

41:45.t: Of old we gave the Book to Moses, and disputes arose about it: and if a decree of respite from thy Lord had gone before, there would surely have been a decision between them: for great were their doubts and questionings about it

41:46.t: He who doth right - it is for himself: and he who doth evil - it is for himself: and thy Lord will not deal unfairly with his servants

41:47.t: With Him alone is the knowledge of "the Hour." No fruit cometh forth from its coverings, neither doth any female conceive, nor is she delivered, but with His knowledge. And on that day He shall call men to Him, saying, "Where are the companions ye gave me?" They shall say, "We own to thee, there is no one of us can witness for them

41:48.t: And what they erst called on shall pass away from them, and they shall perceive that there will be no escape for them

41:49.t: Man ceaseth not to pray for good: but if evil betide him he despondeth, despairing

41:50.t: And if we cause him to taste our mercy after affliction hath touched him, he is sure to say, "This is my due: and I take no thought of the Hour of Resurrection: and if I be brought back to my Lord, I shall indeed attain with Him my highest good." But we will then certainly declare their doings to the Infidels, and cause them to taste a stern punishment

41:51.t: When we are gracious to man, he withdraweth and turneth him aside: but when evil toucheth him, he is a man of long prayers

41:52.t: SAY: What think ye? If this Book be from God and ye believe it not, who will have gone further astray than he who is at a distance from it

41:53.t: We will shew them our signs in different countries and among themselves, until it become plain to them that it is the truth. Is it not enough for thee that thy Lord is witness of all things

41:54.t: Are they not in doubt as to the meeting with their Lord? But doth he not encompass all things

42:3.t: Thus unto thee as unto those who preceded thee doth God, the Mighty, the Wise, reveal

42:4.t: All that is in the Heavens and all that is in the Earth is His: and He is the High, the Great

42:5.t: Ready are the Heavens to cleave asunder from above for very awe: and the angels celebrate the praise of their Lord, and ask forgiveness for the dwellers on earth: Is not God the Indulgent, the Merciful

42:6.t: But whose take aught beside Him as lords - God watcheth them! but thou hast them not in thy charge

42:7.t: It is thus moreover that we have revealed to thee an Arabic Koran, that thou mayest warn the mother city and all around it, and that thou mayest warn them of that day of the Gathering, of which there is no doubt - when part shall be in Paradise and part in the flame

42:8.t: Had God so pleased, He had made them one people and of one creed: but He bringeth whom He will within His mercy; and as for the doers of evil, no patron, no helper shall there be for them

42:9.t: Will they take other patrons than Him? But God is man's only Lord: He quickeneth the dead; and He is mighty over all things

42:10.t: And whatever the subject of your disputes, with God doth its decision rest. This is God, my Lord: in Him do I put my trust, and to Him do I turn in penitence

42:11.t: Creator of the Heavens and of the Earth! he hath given you wives from among your own selves, and cattle male and female - by this means to multiply you: Nought is there like Him! the Hearer, the Beholder He

42:12.t: His, the keys of the Heavens and of the Earth! He giveth with open hand, or sparingly, to whom He will: He knoweth all things

42:13.t: To you hath He prescribed the faith which He commanded unto Noah, and which we have revealed to thee, and which we commanded unto Abraham and Moses and Jesus, saying, "Observe this faith, and be not divided into sects therein." Intolerable to those who worship idols jointly with God Is that faith to which thou dost call them. Whom He pleaseth will God choose for it, and whosoever shall turn to Him in penitence will He guide to it

42:14.t: Nor were they divided into sects through mutual jealousy, till after that "the knowledge" had come to them: and had not a decree from thy Lord gone forth respiting them to a fixed time, verily, there had at once been a decision between them. And they who have inherited "the Book" after them, are in perplexity of doubt concerning it

42:15.t: For this cause summon thou them to the faith, and go straight on as thou hast been bidden, and follow not their desires: and SAY: In whatsoever Books God hath sent down do I believe: I am commanded to decide justly between you: God is your Lord and our Lord: we have our works and you have your works: between us and you let there be no strife: God will make us all one: and to Him shall we return

42:16.t: And as to those who dispute about God, after pledges of obedience given to Him, their disputings shall be condemned by their Lord, and wrath shall be on them, and theirs shall be a sore torment

42:17.t: It is God who hath sent down the Book with truth, and the Balance: but who shall inform thee whether haply "the Hour" be nigh

42:18.t: They who believe not in it, challenge its speedy coming: but they who believe are afraid because of it, and know it to be a truth. Are not they who dispute of the Hour, in a vast error

42:19.t: Benign is God towards his servants: for whom He will doth He provide: and He is the Strong, the Mighty

42:20.t: Whoso will choose the harvest field of the life to come, to him will we give increase in this his harvest field: and whoso chooseth the harvest field of this life, thereof will we give him: but no portion shall there be for him in the life to come

42:21.t: Is it that they have gods who have sanctioned for them aught in the matter of religion which God hath not allowed? But had it not been for a decree of respite till the day of severance, judgment had ere now taken place among them; and assuredly the impious shall undergo a painful torment

42:22.t: On that day thou shalt see the impious alarmed at their own works, and the consequence thereof shall fall upon them: but they who believe and do the things that are right, shall dwell in the meadows of paradise: whatever they shall desire awaiteth them with their Lord. This, the greatest boon

42:23.t: This is what God announceth to his servants who believe and do the things that are right. SAY: For this ask I no wage of you, save the love of my kin. And whoever shall have won the merit of a good deed, we will increase good to him therewith; for God is forgiving, grateful

42:24.t: Will they say he hath forged a lie of God? If God pleased, He could then seal up thy very heart. But God will bring untruth to nought, and will make good the truth by his word: for He knoweth the very secrets of the breast

42:25.t: He it is who accepteth repentance from his servants, and forgiveth their sins and knoweth your actions

42:26.t: And to those who believe and do the things that are right will he hearken, and augment his bounties to them: but the unbelievers doth a terrible punishment await

42:27.t: Should God bestow abundance upon his servants, they might act wantonly on the earth: but He sendeth down what He will by measure; for he knoweth, beholdeth his servants

42:28.t: He it is who after that men have despaired of it, sendeth down the rain, and spreadeth abroad his mercy: He is the Protector, the Praiseworthy

42:29.t: Among his signs is the creation of the Heavens and of the Earth, and the creatures which he hath scattered over both: and, for their gathering together when he will, He is allpowerful

42:30.t: Nor happeneth to you any mishap, but it is for your own handy-work: and yet he forgiveth many things

42:31.t: Ye cannot weaken him on the earth: neither, beside God, patron or helper shall ye have

42:32.t: Among his signs also are the sea-traversing ships like mountains

42:33.t: if such be his will, He lulleth the wind, and they lie motionless on the back of the waves: - truly herein are signs to all the constant, the grateful

42:34.t: Or if, for their ill deserts, He cause them to founder, still He forgiveth much

42:35.t: But they who gainsay our signs shall know that there will be no escape for them

42:36.t: All that you receive is but for enjoyment in this life present: but better and more enduring is a portion with God, for those who believe and put their trust in their Lord

42:37.t: And who avoid the heinous things of crime, and filthiness, and when they are angered, forgive

42:38.t: And who hearken to their Lord, and observe prayer, and whose affairs are guided by mutual COUNSEL, and who give alms of that with which we have enriched them

42:39.t: And who, when a wrong is done them, redress themselves

42:40.t: Yet let the recompense of evil be only a like evil but he who forgiveth and is reconciled, shall be rewarded by God himself; for He loveth not those who act unjustly

42:41.t: And there shall be no way open against those who, after being wronged, avenge themselves

42:42.t: But there shall be a way open against those who unjustly wrong others, and act insolently on the earth in disregard of justice. These! a grievous punishment doth await them

42:43.t: And whoso beareth wrongs with patience and forgiveth; - this verily is a bounden duty

42:44.t: But he whom God shall cause to err, shall thenceforth have no protector. And thou shalt behold the perpetrators of injustice, Exclaiming, when they see the torment, "Is there no way to return

42:45.t: And thou shalt see them when set before it, downcast for the shame: they shall look at it with stealthy glances: and the believers shall say, "Truly are the losers they who have lost themselves and their families on the day of Resurrection! Shall not the perpetrators of injustice be in lasting torment

42:46.t: And no other protectors shall there be to succour them than God; and no pathway for him whom God shall cause to err

42:47.t: Hearken then to your Lord ere the day come, which none can put back when God doth ordain its coming. No place of refuge for you on that day! no denying your own works

42:48.t: But if they turn aside from thee, yet we have not sent thee to be their guardian. 'Tis thine but to preach. When we cause man to taste our gifts of mercy, he rejoiceth in it; but if for their by-gone handy-work evil betide them, then lo! is man ungrateful

42:49.t: God's, the kingdom of the Heavens and of the Earth! He createth what He will! and he giveth daughters to whom He will, and sons to whom He will

42:50.t: Or He giveth them children of both sexes, and He maketh whom He will to be childless; for He is Wise, Powerful

42:51.t: It is not for man that God should speak with him but by vision, or from behind a veil: Or, He sendeth a messenger to reveal, by his permission, what He will: for He is Exalted, Wise

42:52.t: Thus have we sent the Spirit

to thee with a revelation, by our command. Thou knewest not, ere this, what "the Book" was, or what the faith. But we have ordained it for a light: by it will we guide whom we please of our servants. And thou shalt surely guide into the right way

42:53.t: The way of God, whose is all that the Heaven and the Earth contain. Shall not all things return to God

43:3.t: We have made it an Arabic Koran that ye may understand

43:4.t: And it is a transcript of the archetypal Book, kept by us; it is lofty, filled with wisdom

43:5.t: Shall we then turn aside this warning from you because ye are a people who transgress

43:6.t: Yet how many prophets sent we among those of old

43:7.t: But no prophet came to them whom they made not the object of their scorn

43:8.t: Wherefore we destroyed nations mightier than these Meccans in strength; and the example of those of old hath gone before

43:9.t: And if thou ask them who created the Heavens and the Earth, they will say: "The Mighty, the Sage, created them both

43:10.t: Who hath made the Earth as a couch for you, and hath traced out routes therein for your guidance

43:11.t: And who sendeth down out of Heaven the rain in due degree, by which we quicken a dead land; thus shall ye be brought forth from the grave

43:12.t: And who hath created the sexual couples, all of them, and hath made for you the ships and beasts whereon ye ride

43:13.t: That ye may sit balanced on their backs and remember the goodness of your Lord as ye sit so evenly thereon, and say: "Glory to Him who hath subjected these to us! We could not have attained to it of ourselves

43:14.t: And truly unto our Lord shall we return

43:15.t: Yet do they assign to him some of his own servants for offspring! Verily man is an open ingrate

43:16.t: Hath God adopted daughters from among those whom he hath created, and chosen sons for you

43:17.t: But when that is announced to any one of them, which he affirmeth to be the case with the God of Mercy, his face settleth into darkness and he is silent - sad

43:18.t: What! make they a being to be the offspring of God who is brought up among trinkets, and is ever contentious without reason

43:19.t: And they make the angels who are the servants of God of Mercy, females. What! did they witness their creation? Their witness shall be taken down, and they shall hereafter be enquired at

43:20.t: And they say: "Had the God of Mercy so willed it we should never have worshipped them." No knowledge have they in this: they only lie

43:21.t: Have we ere this given them a Book? and do they possess it still

43:22.t: But say they: "Verily we found our fathers of that persuasion, and verily, by their footsteps do we guide ourselves

43:23.t: And thus never before thy time did we send a warner to any city but its wealthy ones said: "Verily we found our fathers with a religion, and in their tracks we tread

43:24.t: SAY, - such was our command to that apostle - "What! even if I bring you a religion more right than that ye found your fathers following?" And they said, "Verily we believe not in your message

43:25.t: Wherefore we took vengeance on them, and behold what hath been the end of those who treated our messengers as liars

43:26.t: And bear in mind when Abraham said to his father and to his people, "Verily I am clear of what ye worship

43:27.t: Save Him who hath created me; for he will vouchsafe me guidance

43:28.t: And this he established as a doctrine that should abide among his posterity, that to God might they be turned

43:29.t: In sooth to these idolatrous Arabians and to their fathers did I allow their full enjoyments, till the truth should come to them, and an undoubted apostle

43:30.t: But now that the truth hath come to them, they say, "'Tis sorcery, and we believe it not

43:31.t: And they say, "Had but this Koran been sent down to some great one of the two cities

43:32.t: Are they then the distributors of thy Lord's Mercy? It is we who distribute their subsistence among them in this world's life; and we raise some of them by grades above others, that the one may take the other to serve him: but better is the mercy of thy Lord than all their hoards

43:33.t: But for fear that all mankind would have become a single people of unbelievers, verily we would certainly have given to those who believe not in the God of Mercy roofs of silver to their houses, and silver stairs to ascend by

43:34.t: And doors of silver to their houses, and couches of silver to recline on

43:35.t: And ORNAMENTS OF GOLD: for all these are merely the good things of the present life; but the next life doth thy Lord reserve for those who fear Him

43:36.t: And whoso shall withdraw from the Warning of the God of Mercy, we will chain a Satan to him, and he shall be his fast companion

43:37.t: For the Satans will turn men aside from the Way, who yet shall deem themselves rightly guided

43:38.t: Until when man shall come before us, he shall say, "O Satan, would that between me and thee were the distance of the East and West." And a wretched companion is a Satan

43:39.t: But it shall not avail you on that day, because ye were unjust: partners shall ye be in the torment

43:40.t: What! Canst thou then make the deaf to hear, or guide the blind and him who is in palpable error

43:41.t: Whether therefore we take thee off by death, surely will we avenge ourselves on them

43:42.t: Or whether we make thee a witness of the accomplishment of that with which we threatened them, we will surely gain the mastery over them

43:43.t: Hold thou fast therefore what hath been revealed to thee, for thou art on a right path

43:44.t: For truly to thee and to thy people it is an admonition; and ye shall have an account to render for it at last

43:45.t: And ask our Sent Ones whom we have sent before thee, "Appointed we gods beside the God of Mercy whom they should worship

43:46.t: Of old sent we Moses with our signs to Pharaoh and his nobles: and he said, "I truly am the Apostle of the Lord of the worlds

43:47.t: And when he presented himself before them with our signs, lo! they laughed at them

43:48.t: Though we shewed them no sign that was not greater than its fellow: and therefore did we lay hold on them with chastisement, to the intent that they might be turned to God

43:49.t: Then they said, "O Magician! call on thy Lord on our behalf to do as he hath engaged with thee, for truly we would fain be guided

43:50.t: But when we relieved them from the chastisement, lo! they broke their pledge

43:51.t: And Pharaoh made proclamation among his people. Said he, "O my people! is not the kingdom of Egypt mine, and these rivers which flow at my feet? Do ye not behold

43:52.t: Am I not mightier than this despicable fellow, And who scarce can speak distinctly

43:53.t: Have bracelets of gold then been put upon him, or come there with him a train of Angels

43:54.t: And he inspired his people with levity, and they obeyed him; for they were a perverse people

43:55.t: And when they had angered us, we took vengeance on them, and we drowned them all

43:56.t: And we made them a precedent and instance of divine judgments to those who came after them

43:57.t: And when the Son of Mary was set forth as an instance of divine power, lo! thy people cried out for joy thereat

43:58.t: And they said, "Are our gods or is he the better?" They put this forth to thee only in the spirit of dispute. Yea, they are a contentious people

43:59.t: Jesus is no more than a servant whom we favoured, and proposed as an instance of divine power to the children of Israel

43:60.t: And if we pleased, we could from yourselves bring forth Angels to succeed you on earth

43:61.t: And he shall be a sign of the last hour; doubt not then of it, and follow ye me: this is the right way

43:62.t: And let not Satan turn you aside from it, for he is your manifest foe

43:63.t: And when Jesus came with manifest proofs, he said, "Now am I come to you with wisdom; and a part of those things about which ye are at variance I will clear up to you; fear ye God therefore and obey me

43:64.t: Verily, God is my Lord and your Lord; wherefore worship ye him: this is a right way

43:65.t: But the different parties fell into disputes among themselves; but woe to those who thus transgressed, because of the punishment of an afflictive day

43:66.t: For what wait they but for the hour "to come suddenly on them, while they expect it not

43:67.t: Friends on that day shall become foes to one another, except the God-fearing

43:68.t: O my servants! on this day shall no fear come upon you, neither shall ye be put to grief

43:69.t: Who have believed in our signs and become Muslims

43:70.t: Enter ye and your wives into Paradise, delighted

43:71.t: Dishes and bowls of gold shall go round unto them: there shall they enjoy whatever their souls desire, and whatever their eyes delight in; and therein shall ye abide for ever

43:72.t: This is Paradise, which ye have received as your heritage in recompense for your works

43:73.t: Therein shall ye have fruits in abundance, of which ye shall eat

43:74.t: But in the torment of Hell shall the wicked remain for ever

43:75.t: It shall not be mitigated to them, and they shall be mute for despair therein

43:76.t: For it is not we who have treated them unjustly, but it was they who were unjust to themselves

43:77.t: And they shall cry: "O Malec! would that thy Lord would make an end of us!" He saith: "Here must ye remain

43:78.t: We have come to you with the truth
, but most of you abhor the truth

43:79.t: Have they drawn tight their toils for thee? We too will tighten ours

43:80.t: Think they that we hear not their secrets and their private talk? Yes, and our angels who are at their sides write them down

43:81.t: SAY: If the God of Mercy had a son, the first would I be to worship him

43:82.t: But far be the Lord of the Heavens and of the Earth, the Lord of the Throne, from that which they impute to Him

43:83.t: Wherefore let them alone, to plunge on, and sport, until they meet the day with which they are menaced

43:84.t: He who is God in the Heavens is God in earth also: and He is the Wise, the Knowing

43:85.t: And Blessed be He whose is the kingdom of the Heavens and of the Earth and of all that is between them; for with Him is the knowledge of the Hour, and to Him shall ye be brought back

43:86.t: The gods whom they call upon beside Him shall not be able to intercede for others: they only shall be able who bore witness to the truth and knew it

43:87.t: If thou ask them who hath created them, they will be sure to say, "God." How then hold they false opinions

43:88.t: And one saith, "O Lord! verily these are people who believe not

43:89.t: Turn thou then from them, and say, "Peace:" In the end they shall know their folly

44:3.t: See! on a blessed night have we sent it down, for we would warn mankind

44:4.t: On the night wherein all things are disposed in wisdom

44:5.t: By virtue of our behest. Lo! we have ever sent forth Apostles

44:6.t: A mercy from thy Lord: he truly heareth and knoweth all things

44:7.t: Lord of the Heavens and of the Earth and of all that is between them, - if ye be firm in faith

44:8.t: There is no God but He! - He maketh alive and killeth! - Your Lord and the Lord of your sires of old

44:9.t: Yet with doubts do they disport them

44:10.t: But mark them on the day when the Heaven shall give out a palpable SMOKE

44:11.t: Which shall enshroud mankind: this will be an afflictive torment

44:12.t: They will cry, "Our Lord! relieve us from this torment: see! we are believers

44:13.t: But how did warning avail them, when an undoubted apostle had come to them

44:14.t: And they turned their backs on him, and said, "Taught by others, possessed

44:15.t: Were we to relieve you from the plague even a little, ye would certainly relapse

44:16.t: On the day when we shall fiercely put forth our great fierceness, we will surely take vengeance on them

44:17.t: Of old, before their time, had we proved the people of Pharaoh, when a noble apostle presented himself to them

44:18.t: Send away with me," cried he, "the servants of God; for I am an apostle worthy of all credit

44:19.t: And exalt not yourselves against God, for I come to you with undoubted power

44:20.t: And I take refuge with Him who is my Lord and your Lord, that ye stone me not

44:21.t: And if ye believe me not, at least separate yourselves from me

44:22.t: And he cried to his Lord, "That these are a wicked people

44:23.t: March forth then, said God, with my servants by night, for ye will be pursued

44:24.t: And leave behind you the cleft sea: they are a drowned host

44:25.t: How many a garden and fountain did they quit

44:26.t: And corn fields and noble dwellings

44:27.t: And pleasures in which they rejoiced them

44:28.t: So was it: and we gave them as a heritage to another people

44:29.t: Nor Heaven nor Earth wept for them, nor was their sentence respited

44:30.t: And we rescued the children of Israel from a degrading affliction

44:31.t: From Pharaoh, for he was haughty, given to excess

44:32.t: And we chose them, in our prescience, above all peoples

44:33.t: And we shewed them miracles wherein was their clear trial

44:35.t: There is but our first death, neither shall we be raised again

44:36.t: Bring back our sires, if ye be men of truth

44:37.t: Are they better than the people of Tobba, And those who flourished before them whom we destroyed for their evil deeds

44:38.t: We have not created the Heavens and the Earth and whatever is between them in sport

44:39.t: We have not created them but for a serious end: but the greater part of them understand it not

44:40.t: Verily the day of severing shall be the appointed time of all

44:41.t: A day when the master shall not at all be aided by the servant, neither shall they be helped

44:42.t: Save those on whom God shall have mercy: for He is the mighty, the merciful

44:45.t: Like dregs of oil shall it boil up in their bellies

44:46.t: Like the boiling of scalding water

44:47.t: Seize ye him, and drag him into the mid-fire

44:48.t: Then pour on his head of the tormenting boiling water

44:49.t: Taste this:' for thou forsooth art the mighty, the honourable

44:50.t: Lo! this is that of which ye doubted

44:51.t: But the pious shall be in a secure place

44:53.t: Clothed in silk and richest robes, facing one another

44:54.t: Thus shall it be: and we will wed them to the virgins with large dark eyes

44:55.t: Therein shall they call, secure, for every kind of fruit

44:56.t: Therein, their first death passed, shall they taste death no more; and He shall keep them from the pains of Hell

44:57.t: Tis the gracious bounty of thy Lord! This is the great felicity

44:58.t: We have made this Koran easy for thee in thine own tongue, that they may take the warning

44:59.t: Therefore wait thou, for they are waiting

45:2.t: This Book is sent down from God, the Mighty, the Wise

45:3.t: Assuredly in the Heavens and the Earth are signs for those who believe

45:4.t: And in your own creation, and in the beasts which are scattered abroad are signs to the firm in faith

45:5.t: And in the succession of night and day, and in the supply which God sendeth down from the Heaven whereby He giveth life to the earth when dead, and in the change of the winds, are signs for a people of discernment

45:6.t: Such are the signs of God: with truth do we recite them to thee. But in what teaching will they believe, if they reject God and his signs

45:8.t: Who heareth the signs of God recited to him, and then, as though he heard them not, persisteth in proud disdain! Apprise him of an afflictive punishment

45:9.t: And when he becometh acquainted with any of our signs he turneth them into ridicule. These! a shameful punishment for them

45:10.t: Hell is behind them! and neither their gains nor the lords whom they have adopted beside God shall avail them in the least: and theirs, a great punishment

45:11.t: This is "Guidance:" and for those who disbelieve the signs of their Lord is the punishment of an afflictive torment

45:12.t: It is God who hath subjected the sea to you that the ships may traverse it at his bidding, and that ye may go in quest of the gifts of his bounty, and that ye may be thankful

45:13.t: And he hath subjected to you all that is in the Heavens and all that is on the Earth: all is from him. Verily, herein are signs for those who reflect

45:14.t: Tell the believers to pardon those who hope not for the days of God in which He purposeth to reward men according to their deeds

45:15.t: He who doth that which is right, doth it to his own behoof, and whoso doth evil, doth it to his own hurt. Hereafter, to your Lord shall ye be brought back

45:16.t: To the children of Israel gave we of old the Book and the Wisdom, and the gift of Prophecy, and we supplied them with good things, and privileged them above all peoples

45:17.t: And we gave them clear sanctions for our behests: neither did they differ, through mutual envy, till after they had become possessed of knowledge; but thy Lord will judge between them on the day of resurrection, as to the subject of their disputes

45:18.t: Afterwards we set thee over our divine law: follow it then: and follow not the wishes of those who have no knowledge

45:19.t: For against God shall they avail thee nothing. And in sooth, the doers of evil are one another's patrons; but the patron of them that fear Him is God himself

45:20.t: This Book hath insight for mankind, and a Guidance and Mercy to a people who are firm in faith

45:21.t: Deem they whose gettings are only evil, that we will deal with them as with those who believe and work righteousness, so that their lives and deaths shall be alike? Ill do they judge

45:22.t: In all truth hath God created the Heavens and the Earth, that he may reward every one as he shall have wrought; and they shall not be wronged

45:23.t: What thinkest thou? He who hath made a God of his passions, and whom God causeth wilfully to err, and whose ears and whose heart he hath sealed up, and over whose sight he hath placed a veil - who, after his rejection by God, shall guide such a one? Will ye not then be warned

45:24.t: And they say, "There is only this our present life: we die and we live, and nought but time destroyeth us." But in this they have no knowledge: it is merely their own conceit

45:25.t: And when our clear signs are recited to them, their only argument is to say, "Bring back our fathers, if ye speak the truth

45:26.t: Say: God giveth you life, then causeth you to die: then will He assemble you on the day of resurrection: there is no doubt of it: but most men have not this knowledge

45:27.t: And God's is the kingdom of the Heavens and of the Earth; and on the day when the Hour shall arrive, on that day shall the despisers perish

45:28.t: And thou shalt see every nation KNEELING: to its own book shall every nation be summoned: - "This day shall ye be repaid as ye have wrought

45:29.t: This our Book will speak of you with truth: therein have we written down whatever ye have done

45:30.t: As to those who have believed and wrought righteously, into his mercy shall their Lord cause them to enter. This shall be undoubted bliss

45:31.t: But as to the Infidels - "Were not my signs recited to you? but ye proudly scorned them, and became a sinful people

45:32.t: And when it was said, "Verily the Promise of God is truth; and as to the Hour, there is no doubt of it;" ye said, "We know not what the hour is - we conceive it a mere conceit, - we have no assurance of it

45:33.t: And the evils they have wrought shall rise up into their view, and that at which they mocked shall hem them in on every side

45:34.t: And it shall be said to them, "This day will we forget you as ye forgat your meeting with us this day, and your abode shall be the fire, and none shall there be to succour you

45:35.t: This, because ye received the signs of God with mockery, and this present life deceived you." On that day therefore they shall not come out from it; and they shall not be asked to win the favour of God

45:36.t: Praise then be to God, Lord of the Heavens and Lord of the Earth; the Lord of the worlds

45:37.t: And His be the greatness in the Heavens and on the Earth; for He is the Mighty, the Wise

46:2.t: of this Book is from the Mighty, the Wise

46:3.t: We have not created the Heavens and the Earth and all that is between them otherwise than in truth and for a settled term. But they who believe not, turn away from their warning
