63:4.t: When thou seest them, their persons make thee marvel; and if they speak, thou listenest with pleasure to their discourse. Like timbers are they leaning against a wall! They think that every shout is against them. They are enemies - Beware of them then - God do battle with them! How false are they

63:5.t: And when it is said to them, "Come, the Apostle of God will ask pardon for you," they turn their heads aside, and thou seest them withdraw in their pride

63:6.t: Alike shall it be to them whether thou ask forgiveness for them, or ask it not. By no means will God forgive them: God hath no guidance for a perverse people

63:7.t: These are they who say to you of Medina, "Spend not aught upon those who are with the Apostle of God, and they will be forced to quit him." Yet the treasures of the Heavens and of the Earth are God's! But the Hypocrites have no understanding

63:8.t: They say: "If we return to the city, the mightier will assuredly drive out the weaker from it." But might is with God, and with the Apostle, and with the Faithful! Yet the Hypocrites understand not

63:9.t: O ye who believe! let not your wealth and your children delude you into forgetfulness of God. Whoever shall act thus, shall surely suffer loss

63:10.t: And expend in the cause of God out of that with which we have supplied you, ere death surprise each one of you, and he say, "O Lord! wilt thou not respite me to a term not far distant, that I may give alms, and become one of the just

63:11.t: And by no means will God respite a soul when its hour hath come! And God is fully cognisant of what ye do

64:1.t: ALL that is in the Heavens, and all that is in the Earth, praiseth God: His the Kingdom and His the Glory! And He hath power over all things

64:2.t: It is He who hath created you all; yet some of you are infidel and others believers: but God beholdeth all your actions

64:3.t: He hath created the Heavens and the Earth in Truth; and He hath fashioned you and given you goodly forms; and to Him must ye all return

64:4.t: He knoweth all that passeth in the Heavens and in the Earth; and He knoweth what ye hide and what ye bring to light; and God knoweth the very secrets of men's breasts

64:5.t: Hath not the story reached you of those who disbelieved of yore, and therefore tasted the evil consequences of their doings? And a sore punishment doth await them

64:6.t: This, for that when their apostles came to them with the clear tokens, they said, "What! shall men be our guides?" And they believed not and turned their backs. But God can dispense with them; for God is the Rich, the Praiseworthy

64:7.t: The infidels pretend that they shall not be raised from the dead. SAY: Yea, by my Lord, ye shall surely be raised; then shall ye surely be told of your deeds! And easy is this for God

64:8.t: Believe then in God and his apostle and in the light which we have sent down; for God is fully aware of all ye do

64:9.t: The day when He shall gather you together for the day of mutual gathering, will be the day of MUTUAL DECEIT, and whoso shall have believed in God and done what is right, for him will He cancel his deeds of evil; and He will bring him into the gardens beneath whose shades the rivers flow, to abide therein for evermore. This will be the great bliss

64:10.t: But the unbelieving - those who gave the lie to our signs - shall be the inmates of the fire, wherein they shall remain for ever. And a wretched passage thither

64:11.t: No mischance chanceth but by God's permission; and whoso believeth in God, that man's heart will he guide: and God knoweth all things

64:12.t: Obey God then and obey the apostle: but if ye turn away, our apostle is not to blame, for he is only charged with plain preaching

64:13.t: God! there is no God but He! On God, then, let the faithful trust

64:14.t: O ye who believe! Verily, in your wives and your children ye have an enemy: wherefore beware of them. But if ye pass it over and pardon, and are lenient, then God too is Lenient, Merciful

64:15.t: Your wealth and your children are only a source of trial! but God! with Him is the great recompense

64:16.t: Fear God, then, with all your might, and hear and obey: and give alms for your own weal; for such as are saved from their own greed, shall prosper

64:17.t: If ye lend God a generous loan, He will double it to you and will forgive you, for God is Grateful, Long-suffering

64:18.t: He knoweth alike the Hidden and the Manifest: the Mighty, the Wise

65:1.t: O PROPHET! when ye divorce women, divorce them at their special times. And reckon those times exactly, and fear God your Lord. Put them not forth from their houses, nor allow them to depart, unless they have committed a proven adultery. This is the precept of God; and whoso transgresseth the precept of God, assuredly imperilleth his own self. Thou knowest not whether, after this, God may not cause something new to occur which may bring you together again

65:2.t: And when they have reached their set time, then either keep them with kindness, or in kindness part from them. And take upright witnesses from among you, and bear witness as unto God. This is a caution for him who believeth in God and in the latter day. And whoso feareth God, to him will He grant a prosperous issue, and will provide for him whence he reckoned not upon it

65:3.t: And for him who putteth his trust in Him will God be all-sufficient. God truly will attain his purpose. For everything hath God assigned a period

65:4.t: As to such of your wives as have no hope of the recurrence of their times, if ye have doubts in regard to them, then reckon three months, and let the same be the term of those who have not yet had them. And as to those who are with child, their period shall be until they are delivered of their burden. God will make His command easy to him who feareth Him

65:5.t: This is God's command which He hath sent down to you: Whoso feareth God, his evil deeds will He cancel and will increase his reward

65:6.t: Lodge the divorced wherever ye lodge, according to your means; and distress them not by putting them to straits. And if they are pregnant, then be at charges for the them till they are delivered of their burden; and if they suckle your children, then pay them their hire and consult among yourselves, and act generously: And if herin ye meet with obstacles, then let another female suckle for him

65:7.t: Let him who hath abundance of his abundance; let him, too, whose store is scanty, give of what God hath vouchsafed to him. God imposeth burdens only according to the means which He hath given. God will cause ease to succeed difficulties

65:8.t: How many cities have turned aside from the command of their Lord and of his apostles! Therefore did we reckon with them in a severe reckoning, and chastised them with a stern chastisement

65:9.t: And they tasted the harmfulness of their own conduct: and the end of their conduct was ruin

65:10.t: A vehement chastisement hath God prepared for them! Fear God, then, O ye men of understanding! Believers! Now hath God sent down to you a warning

65:11.t: a prophet, who reciteth to you the clear signs of God, that he may bring those who believe, and do the things that are right, out of the darkness into the light. And - whoso believeth in God, and doeth the things that are right, God will cause them to enter the gardens beneath which the rivers flow, to remain therein for aye! A goodly provision now hath God made for him

65:12.t: It is God who hath created seven heavens and as many earths. The Divine command cometh down through them all, that ye may know that God hath power over all things, and that God in his knowledge embraceth all things

66:1.t: WHY, O Prophet! dost thou hold that to be FORBIDDEN which God hath made lawful to thee, from a desire to please thy wives, since God is Lenient, Merciful

66:2.t: God hath allowed you release from your oaths; and God is your master: and He is the Knowing, Wise

66:3.t: When the prophet told a recent occurrence as a secret to one of his wives, and when she divulged it and God informed him of this, he acquainted her with part and withheld part. And when he had told her of it, she said, "Who told thee this?" He said, "The Knowing, the Sage hath told it me

66:4.t: If ye both be turned to God in penitence, for now have your hearts gone astray.... but if ye conspire against the Prophet, then know that God is his Protector, and Gabriel, and every just man among the faithful; and the angels are his helpers besides

66:5.t: Haply if he put you both away, his Lord will give him in exchange other wives better than you, Muslims, believers, devout, penitent, obedient, observant of fasting, both known of men and virgins

66:6.t: O Believers! save yourselves and your families from the fire whose fuel is men and stones, over which are set angels fierce and mighty: they disobey not God in what He hath commanded them, but execute His behests

66:7.t: O ye Infidels! make no excuses for yourselves this day; ye shall surely be recompensed according to your works

66:8.t: O Believers! turn to God with the turning of true penitence; haply your Lord will cancel your evil deeds, and will bring you into the gardens 'neath which the rivers flow, on the day when God will not shame the Prophet, nor those who have shared his faith: their light shall run before them, and on their right hands! they shall say, "Lord perfect our light, and pardon us: for thou hast power over all things

66:9.t: O Prophet! make war on the infidels and hypocrites, and deal rigorously with them. Hell shall be their abode! and wretched the passage to it

66:10.t: God setteth forth as an example to unbelievers the wife of Noah and the wife of Lot; they were under two of our righteous servants, both of whom they deceived: but their husbands availed them nought against God: and it shall be said "Enter ye into the fire with those who enter

66:11.t: God also holdeth forth to those who believe the example of the wife of Pharaoh, when she said, "Lord, build me an house with thee in Paradise, and deliver me from Pharaoh and his doings; and deliver me from the wicked

66:12.t: And Mary, the daughter of Imran, who kept her maidenhood, and into whose womb we breathed of our spirit, and who believed in the words of her Lord and His Scriptures, and was one of the devout

67:1.t: BLESSED be He is whose hand is the KINGDOM! and over all things is He potent

67:2.t: Who hath created death and life to prove which of you will be most righteous in deed; and He is the Mighty, the Forgiving

67:3.t: Who hath created seven Heavens one above another: No defect canst thou see in the creation of the God of Mercy: Repeat the gaze: seest thou a single flaw

67:4.t: Then twice more repeat the gaze: thy gaze shall return to thee dulled and weary

67:5.t: Moreover we have decked the lowest heaven with lights, and have placed them there to be hurled at the Satans, for whom we have prepared the torment of the flaming fire

67:6.t: And for those who believe not in their Lord is the torment of Hell; and horrid the journey thither

67:7.t: When they shall be thrown into it, they shall hear it braying: and it shall boil

67:8.t: Almost shall it burst for fury. So oft as a crowd shall be thrown into it, its keepers shall ask them, "Came not the warner to you

67:9.t: They shall say, Yes! there came to us one charged with warnings; but we treated him as a liar, and said, "Nothing hath God sent down: ye are in nothing but a vast delusion

67:10.t: And they shall say, "Had we but hearkened or understood, we had not been among the dwellers in the flames

67:11.t: And their sin shall they acknowledge: but, "Avaunt, ye dwellers in the flame

67:12.t: But pardon and a great reward for those who fear their Lord in secret

67:13.t: Be your converse hidden or open, He truly knoweth the inmost recess of your breasts

67:14.t: What! shall He not know who hath created? for He is the Subtil, the Cognizant

67:15.t: It is He who hath made the earth level for you: traverse then its broad sides, and eat of what He hath provided. - Unto Him shall be the resurrection

67:16.t: What! are ye sure that He who is in Heaven will not cleave the Earth beneath you? And lo, it shall quake

67:17.t: Or are ye sure that He who is in Heaven will not send against you a stone-charged whirlwind? Then shall ye know what my warning meant

67:18.t: And verily, those who flourish before you treated their prophets as liars: and how grievous my wrath

67:19.t: Behold they not the birds over their heads, outstretching and drawing in their wings? None, save the God of Mercy, upholdeth them: for he regardeth all things

67:20.t: Who is he that can be as an army to you, to succour you, except the God of Mercy? Truly, the infidels are in the merest delusion

67:21.t: Or who is he that will furnish you supplies, if He withhold His supplies? Yet do they persist in pride and in fleeing from Him

67:22.t: Is he who goeth along grovelling on his face, better guided than he who goeth upright on a straight path

67:23.t: SAY: It is He who hath brought you forth, and gifted you with hearing and sight and heart: yet how few are grateful

67:24.t: SAY: It is He who hath sown you in the earth, and to Him shall ye be gathered

67:25.t: And they say, "When shall this threat be put in force, if ye speak the truth

67:26.t: SAY: Nay truly, this knowledge is with God alone: and I am only an open warner

67:27.t: But when they shall see it nigh, sad shall wax the countenances of the infidels: and it shall be said, "This is what ye have been calling for

67:28.t: SAY: What think ye? Whether God destroy me or not, and those who follow me, or whether he have mercy on us, yet who will protect the infidels from a woeful torment

67:29.t: SAY: He is the God of Mercy: in Him do we believe, and in Him put we our trust; and ye shall know hereafter who is in a manifest error

67:30.t: SAY: What think ye? If at early morn your waters shall have sunk away, who then will give you clear running water

68:1.t: Nun. By the PEN and by what they write

68:2.t: Thou, O Prophet; by the grace of thy Lord art not possessed

68:3.t: And truly a boundless recompense doth await thee

68:4.t: For thou art of a noble nature

68:5.t: But thou shalt see and they shall see

68:6.t: Which of you is the demented

68:7.t: Now thy Lord! well knoweth He the man who erreth from his path, and well doth he know those who have yielded to Guidance

68:8.t: Give not place, therefore, to those who treat thee as a liar

68:9.t: They desire thee to deal smoothly with them: then would they be smooth as oil with thee

68:10.t: But yield not to the man of oaths, a despicable person

68:12.t: Hinderer of the good, transgressor, criminal

68:13.t: Harsh - beside this, impure by birth

68:14.t: Though a man of riches and blessed with sons

68:15.t: Who when our wondrous verses are recited to him saith - "Fables of the ancients

68:16.t: We will brand him on the nostrils

68:17.t: as we proved the owners of the garden, when they swore that at morn they would cut its fruits

68:19.t: Wherefore an encircling desolation from thy Lord swept round it while they slumbered

68:20.t: And in the morning it was like a garden whose fruits had all been cut

68:21.t: Then at dawn they called to each other

68:22.t: Go out early to your field, if ye would cut your dates

68:23.t: So on they went whispering to each other

68:24.t: No poor man shall set foot this day within your garden

68:25.t: And they went out at daybreak with this settled purpose

68:26.t: But when they beheld it, they said, "Truly we have been in fault

68:27.t: Yes! we are forbidden our fruits

68:28.t: The most rightminded of them said, "Did I not say to you, Will ye not give praise to God

68:29.t: They said, "Glory to our Lord! Truly we have done amiss

68:30.t: And they fell to blaming one another

68:31.t: They said, "Oh woe to us! we have indeed transgressed

68:32.t: Haply our Lord will give us in exchange a better garden than this: verily we crave it of our Lord

68:33.t: Such hath been our chastisement - but heavier shall be the chastisement of the next world. Ah! did they but know it

68:34.t: Verily, for the God-fearing are gardens of delight in the presence of their Lord

68:35.t: Shall we then deal with those who have surrendered themselves to God, as with those who offend him

68:36.t: What hath befallen you that ye thus judge

68:37.t: Have ye a Scripture wherein ye can search out

68:38.t: That ye shall have the things ye choose

68:39.t: Or have ye received oaths which shall bind Us even until the day of the resurrection, that ye shall have what yourselves judge right

68:40.t: Ask them which of them will guarantee this

68:41.t: Or is it that they have joined gods with God? let them produce those associate-gods of theirs, if they speak truth

68:42.t: On the day when men's legs shall be bared, and they shall be called upon to bow in adoration, they shall not be able

68:43.t: Their looks shall be downcast: shame shall cover them: because, while yet in safety, they were invited to bow in worship, but would not obey

68:44.t: Leave me alone therefore with him who chargeth this revelation with imposture. We will lead them by degrees to their ruin; by ways which they know not

68:45.t: Yet will I bear long with them; for my plan is sure

68:46.t: Askest thou any recompense from them? But they are burdened with debt

68:47.t: Are the secret things within their ken? Do they copy them from the Book of God

68:48.t: Patiently then await the judgment of thy Lord, and be not like him who was in the fish, when in deep distress he cried to God

68:49.t: Had not favour from his Lord reached him, cast forth would he have been on the naked shore, overwhelmed with shame

68:50.t: But his Lord chose him and made him of the just

68:51.t: Almost would the infidels strike thee down with their very looks when they hear the warning of the Koran. And they say, "He is certainly possessed

68:52.t: Yet is it nothing less than a warning for all creatures

69:3.t: And who shall make thee comprehend what the Inevitable is

69:4.t: Themoud and Ad treated the day of Terrors as a lie

69:5.t: So as to Themoud, they were destroyed by crashing thunder bolts

69:6.t: And as to Ad, they were destroyed by a roaring and furious blast

69:7.t: It did the bidding of God against them seven nights and eight days together, during which thou mightest have seen the people laid low, as though they had been the trunks of hollow palms

69:8.t: And couldst thou have seen one of them surviving

69:9.t: Pharaoh also, and those who flourished before him, and the overthrown cities, committed sin

69:10.t: And disobeyed the Sent one of their Lord; therefore did he chastise them with an accumulated chastisement

69:11.t: When the Flood rose high, we bare you in the Ark

69:12.t: That we might make that event a warning to you, and that the retaining ear might retain it

69:13.t: But when one blast shall be blown on the trumpet

69:14.t: And the earth and the mountains shall be upheaved, and shall both be crushed into dust at a single crushing

69:15.t: On that day the woe that must come suddenly shall suddenly come

69:16.t: And the heaven shall cleave asunder, for on that day it shall be fragile

69:17.t: And the angels shall be on its sides, and over them on that day eight shall bear up the throne of thy Lord

69:18.t: On that day ye shall be brought before Him: none of your hidden deeds shall remain hidden

69:19.t: And he who shall have his book given to him in his right hand, will say to his friends, "Take ye it; read ye my book

69:20.t: I ever thought that to this my reckoning I should come

69:21.t: And his shall be a life that shall please him well

69:23.t: Whose clusters shall be near at hand

69:24.t: Eat ye and drink with healthy relish, as the meed of what ye sent on beforehand in the days which are past

69:25.t: But he who shall have his book given into his left hand, will say, "O that my book had never been given me

69:26.t: And that I had never known my reckoning

69:27.t: O that death had made an end of me

69:28.t: My wealth hath not profited me

69:29.t: My power hath perished from me

69:30.t: Lay ye hold on him and chain him

69:31.t: Then at the Hell-fire burn him

69:32.t: Then into a chain whose length is seventy cubits thrust him

69:33.t: For he believed not in God, the Great

69:34.t: And was not careful to feed the poor

69:35.t: No friend therefore shall he have here this day

69:37.t: Which none shall eat but the sinners

69:38.t: It needs not that I swear by what ye see

69:39.t: And by that which ye see not

69:40.t: That this verily is the word of an apostle worthy of all honour

69:41.t: And that it is not the word of a poet - how little do ye believe

69:42.t: Neither is it the word of a soothsayer
- how little do ye receive warning

69:43.t: It is a missive from the Lord of the worlds

69:44.t: But if Muhammad had fabricated concerning us any sayings

69:45.t: We had surely seized him by the right hand

69:46.t: And had cut through the vein of his neck

69:47.t: Nor would We have withheld any one of you from him

69:48.t: is a warning for the God-fearing

69:49.t: And we well know that there are of you who treat it as a falsehood

69:50.t: But it shall be the despair of infidels

69:51.t: For it is the very truth of sure knowledge

69:52.t: Praise, then, the name of thy Lord, the Great

70:1.t: A SUITOR sued for punishment to light suddenly

70:2.t: On the infidels: none can hinder

70:3.t: God from inflicting it, the master of those ASCENTS

70:4.t: By which the angels and the spirit ascend to him in a day, whose length is fifty thousand years

70:5.t: Be thou patient therefore with becoming patience

70:6.t: They forsooth regard that day as distant

70:8.t: The day when the heavens shall become as molten brass

70:9.t: And the mountains shall become like flocks of wool

70:10.t: And friend shall not question of friend

70:11.t: Though they look at one another. Fain would the wicked redeem himself from punishment on that day at the price of his children

70:12.t: Of his spouse and his brother

70:13.t: And of his kindred who shewed affection for him

70:14.t: And of all who are on the earth that then it might deliver him

70:17.t: Shall claim him who turned his back and went away

70:19.t: Man truly is by creation hasty

70:21.t: But when good falleth to his lot, tenacious

70:23.t: Who are ever constant at their prayers

70:24.t: And of whose substance there is a due and stated portion

70:25.t: For him who asketh, and for him who is ashamed to beg

70:26.t: And who own the judgment - day a truth

70:27.t: And who thrill with dread at the chastisement of their Lord

70:28.t: For there is none safe from the chastisement of their Lord

70:30.t: Save with their wives or the slaves whom their right hands have won, for there they shall be blameless

70:31.t: But whoever indulge their desires beyond this are transgressors

70:32.t: And who are true to their trusts and their engagements

70:34.t: And who keep strictly the hours of prayer

70:35.t: These shall dwell, laden with honours, amid gardens

70:36.t: But what hath come to the unbelievers that they run at full stretch around thee

70:37.t: On the right hand and on the left, in bands

70:38.t: Is it that every man of them would fain enter that garden of delights

70:39.t: Not at all. We have created them, they know of what

70:40.t: It needs not that I swear by the Lord of the East and of the West that we have power

70:41.t: To replace them with better than themselves: neither are we to be hindered

70:42.t: Wherefore let them flounder on and disport them, till they come face to face with their threatened day

70:43.t: The day on which they shall flock up out of their graves in haste like men who rally to a standard

70:44.t: Their eyes downcast; disgrace shall cover them. Such their threatened day

71:1.t: We sent NOAH to his people, and said to him, "Warn thou thy people ere there come on them an afflictive punishment

71:2.t: He said, "O my people! I come to you a plain-spoken warner

71:3.t: Serve God and fear Him, and obey me

71:4.t: Your sins will He forgive you, and respite you till the fixed Time; for when God's fixed Time hath come, it shall not be put back. Would that ye knew this

71:5.t: He said, "Lord I have cried to my people night and day

71:6.t: and my cry doth but make them flee from me the more

71:7.t: So oft as I cry to them, that thou mayest forgive them, they thrust their fingers into their ears, and wrap themselves in their garments, and persist in their error, and are disdainfully disdainful

71:8.t: Then I cried aloud to them

71:9.t: Then again spake I with plainness, and in private did I secretly address them

71:10.t: And I said, Beg forgiveness of your Lord, for He is ready to forgive

71:11.t: He will send down the very Heaven upon you in plenteous rains

71:12.t: And will increase you in wealth and children; and will give you gardens, and will give you watercourses

71:13.t: What hath come to you that ye hope not for goodness from the hand of God

71:14.t: For He it is who hath formed you by successive steps

71:15.t: See ye not how God hath created the seven heavens one over the other

71:16.t: And He hath placed therein the moon as a light, and hath placed there the sun as a torch

71:17.t: And God hath caused you to spring forth from the earth like a plant

71:18.t: Hereafter will He turn you back into it again, and will bring you forth anew

71:19.t: And God hath spread the earth for you like a carpet

71:20.t: That ye may walk therein along spacious paths

71:21.t: Said Noah, "O my Lord! they rebel against me, and they follow those whose riches and children do but aggravate their ruin

71:22.t: And they plotted a great plot

71:23.t: And they said, "Forsake not your gods; forsake not Wadd nor Sowah, Nor Yaghuth and Yahuk and Nesr

71:24.t: And they caused many to err; - and thou, too, O Muhammad! shalt be the means of increasing only error in the wicked

71:25.t: Because of their sins they were drowned, and made to go into the Fire; And they found that they had no helper save God

71:26.t: And Noah said, "Lord, leave not one single family of Infidels on the Earth

71:27.t: For if thou leave them they will beguile thy servants and will beget only sinners, infidels

71:28.t: O my Lord, forgive me, and my parents, and every one who, being a believer, shall enter my house, and believers men and women: and add to the wicked nought but perdition

72:1.t: SAY: It hath been revealed to me that a company of DJINN listened, and said, - "Verily, we have heard a marvellous discourse

72:2.t: It guideth to the truth; wherefore we believed in it, and we will not henceforth join any being with our Lord

72:3.t: And He, - may the majesty of our Lord be exalted! - hath taken no spouse neither hath he any offspring

72:4.t: But the foolish among us hath spoken of God that which is unjust

72:5.t: And we verily thought that no one amongst men or Djinn would have uttered a lie against God

72:6.t: There are indeed people among men, who have sought for refuge unto people among Djinn: but they only increased their folly

72:7.t: And they thought, as ye think, that God would not raise any from the dead

72:8.t: And the Heavens did we essay, but found them filled with a mighty garrison, and with flaming darts

72:9.t: And we sat on some of the seats to listen, but whoever listeneth findeth an ambush ready for him of flaming darts

72:10.t: And truly we know not whether evil be meant for them that are on earth, or whether their Lord meaneth guidance for them

72:11.t: And there are among us good, and others among us of another kind; - we are of various sorts

72:12.t: And verily we thought that no one could weaken God on earth, neither could we escape from him by flight

72:13.t: Wherefore as soon as we had heard 'the guidance' we believed in it; and whoever believeth in his Lord, need not fear either loss or wrong

72:14.t: There are some among us who have resigned themselves to God
; and there are others of us who have gone astray. And whoso resigneth himself to God pursueth the way of truth

72:15.t: But they who go astray from it shall be fuel for Hell

72:16.t: keep straight on in that way, we will surely give them to drink of abundant waters

72:17.t: That we may prove them thereby: but whoso withdraweth from the remembrance of his Lord, him will He send into a severe torment

72:18.t: It is unto God that the temples are set apart: call not then on any other therein with God

72:19.t: When the servant of God stood up to call upon Him, the djinn almost jostled him by their crowds

72:20.t: SAY: I call only upon my Lord, and I join no other being with Him

72:21.t: SAY: No control have I over what may hurt or benefit you

72:22.t: SAY: Verily none can protect me against God; Neither shall I find any refuge beside Him

72:23.t: My sole work is preaching from God, and His message: and for such as shall rebel against God and his apostle is the fire of Hell! they shall remain therein alway, - for ever

72:24.t: Until they see their threatened vengeance they will be perverse! but then shall they know which side was the weakest in a protector and the fewest in number

72:25.t: SAY: I know not whether that with which ye are threatened be nigh, or whether my Lord hath assigned it to a distant day

72:26.t: He knoweth the secret, nor doth He divulge his secret to any

72:27.t: Except to that Apostle who pleaseth Him; and before him and behind him He maketh a guard to march

72:28.t: That He may know if his Apostles have verily delivered the messages of their Lord: and He embraceth in his knowledge all their ways, and taketh count of all that concerneth them

73:1.t: O THOU ENFOLDED in thy mantle

73:2.t: Stand up all night, except a small portion of it, for prayer

73:3.t: Half; or curtail the half a little

73:4.t: Or add to it: And with measured tone intone the Koran

73:5.t: For we shall devolve on thee weighty words

73:6.t: Verily, at the oncoming of night are devout impressions strongest, and words are most collected

73:7.t: But in the day time thou hast continual employ

73:8.t: And commemorate the name of thy Lord, and devote thyself to Him with entire devotion

73:9.t: Lord of the East and of the West! No God is there but He! Take Him for thy protector

73:10.t: And endure what they say with patience, and depart from them with a decorous departure

73:11.t: And let Me alone with the gainsayers, rich in the pleasures of this life; and bear thou with them yet a little while

73:12.t: For with Us are strong fetters, and a flaming fire

73:13.t: And food that choketh, and a sore torment

73:14.t: The day cometh when the earth and the mountains shall be shaken; and the mountains shall become a loose sand heap

73:15.t: Verily, we have sent you an Apostle to witness against you, even as we sent an Apostle to Pharaoh

73:16.t: But Pharaoh rebelled against the Apostle, and we therefore laid hold on him with a severe chastisement

73:17.t: And how, if ye believe not, will you screen yourselves from the day that shall turn children greyheaded

73:18.t: The very heaven shall be reft asunder by it: this threat shall be carried into effect

73:19.t: Lo! this is a warning. Let him then who will, take the way to his Lord

73:20.t: Of a truth, thy Lord knoweth that thou prayest almost two-thirds, or half, or a third of the night, as do a part of thy followers. But God measureth the night and the day: He knoweth that ye cannot count its hours aright, and therefore, turneth to you mercifully. Recite then so much of the Koran as may be easy to you. He knoweth that there will be some among you sick, while others travel through the earth in quest of the bounties of God; and others do battle in his cause. Recite therefore so much of it as may be easy. And observe the Prayers and pay the legal Alms, and lend God a liberal loan: for whatever good works ye send on before for your own behoof, ye shall find with God. This will be best and richest in the recompense. And seek the forgiveness of God: verily, God is forgiving, Merciful

74:6.t: And bestow not favours that thou mayest receive again with increase

Thus God misleadeth whom He will, and whom He will doth He guide aright: and none knoweth the armies of thy Lord but Himself: and this is no other than a warning to mankind

76:25.t: And make mention of the name of thy Lord at morn, at even

76:29.t: This truly is a warning: And whoso willeth, taketh the way to his Lord

76:30.t: But will it ye shall not, unless God will it, for God is Knowing, Wise

76:31.t: He causeth whom He will to enter into his mercy. But for the evil doers, He hath made ready an afflictive chastisement
